sa: जानामि भरतं क्षान्तं गुरुसत्कारकारिणम्। सर्वमेवात्र कल्याणं सत्यसंधे महात्मनि॥
en: I know Bharata to be forgiving, and given to serving superiors. Everything in that high-souled one intent on truth appear beneficial.

sa: निवर्तयित्वा रामं च तस्याहं दीप्ततेजसः। दासभूतो भविष्यामि सुस्थितेनान्तरात्मना॥
en: And having brought back Rāma, I will in a perfectly contented spirit, became the slave of that one of flaming energy.

sa: एवमुक्तास्ततो देवाः प्रत्यूचुर्वृषभध्वजम्। यत्तेजः क्षुभितं ह्यद्य तद्धरा धारयिष्यति॥
en: Being thus addressed, the gods answered him having the bull for his mark, ‘The earth will today bear your vital flow.'

sa: तस्य देवसमानस्य पार्थिवस्य महात्मनः। नैतदौपयिकं मन्ये भुक्तभोगस्य भोजनम्॥
en: Do not deem this as fit fare for that magnanimous monarch resembling a celestial, who had enjoyed every luxury (in life).

sa: एवमुक्तः समुत्थाय जग्राह चरणौ पितुः॥ भुजाभ्यां पीनवृत्ताभ्यामङ्गदोऽहमिति ब्रुवन्।
en: Thus accosted, Angada rose up and, saying, I (do touch my Sire's feet), embraced his father's feet with his plump arms.

sa: ऊर्मिमन्तमतिक्रम्य सागरं रत्नसंचयम्। मम युद्धं प्रयच्छेति तमुवाच महार्णवम्॥
en: Passing beyond the Sea, with waves upon him, and containing heaps of gemsji e said to the mighty deep-Grant me battle.

sa: व्यजनाभ्यां च मुख्याभ्यां शतपत्रनिभेक्षणम्। चन्द्रहंसप्रकाशाभ्यां वीज्यते न तवाननम्॥
en: Why do not the servants fan you, having eyes like lotus' petals, with chowries white as the moon or a goose?

sa: ताम्यमानं स मां कृच्छादुवाच परमार्थवित्॥ सीदमानो विवृत्ताङ्गोऽचेष्टमानो गतः क्षयम्। संस्तभ्य शोकं धैर्येण स्थिरचित्तो भवाम्यहम्॥ ब्रह्महत्याकृतं तापं हृदयादपनीयताम्। न द्विजातिरहं राजन्मा भूत् ते मनसो व्यथा॥
en: Thereupon that one well versed in the scriptures sinking motionless, with his eyes rolling upwards, and waxing extremely weak, said with difficulty, 'Restraining sorrow, I by dint of patience become calm. Do you remove from your mind the grief caused by the consciousness of having slain a Brāhmaṇa. O king, I belong not to the twice-born race: let not your mind be pained.

sa: उद्घबर्ह शरं नीलस्तस्य गात्रगतं तदा॥ गिरिगह्वरसंलीनं दीप्तमाशीविषं यथा।
en: Thereupon Neela took out that shaft from the person of (Vāli) like to a flaming serpent lurking in a mountain cave.

sa: एते हि दयिता राज्ञः पितुर्दशरथस्य मे। एतैः सुविहितैरश्वैर्भविष्याम्यहमर्चितः॥
en: These are the favourites of my father, Dasaratha, and on these horses being well provided for, I shall be well received.

sa: विकलाभ्यां च नेत्राभ्यामपश्यनिव भूमिपः। कृच्छ्राद् धैर्येण संस्तभ्य कैकेयीमिदब्रवीत्॥
en: Then calming himself with a great effort, the king, as if not seeing Kaikeyi, with his haggard eyes, addressed her, saying.

sa: स तूर्यघोषः सुमहान् दिवमापूरयन्निव। भरतं शोकसंतप्तं भूयः शोकैररन्धयत्॥
en: And as if filling the heavens, those powerful blasts of the trumpet repeatedly rendered Bharata burning in grief the more aggrieved.

sa: ततः कैश्चिदहोरात्रैरुपयाता महीक्षितः॥ बहूनि रत्नान्यादाय राज्ञो दशरथस्य ह।
en: Then for several days, kings began to pour into Dasaratha's city daily and nightly, bringing with them various kinds of gems.

sa: आश्वासयन्तं भरतं जाबालिब्राह्मणोत्तमः। उवाच रामं धर्मज्ञं धर्मापेतमिदं वचः॥
en: As Rāma cognizant of righteousness was thus encouraging Bharata, Jābāli, best of Brāhmaṇas, addressed him in words divorced from morality, saying.

sa: कुतः कल्याणसत्त्वायाः कल्याणाभिरते: सदा। चलनं तात वैदेह्यास्तपस्विषु विशेषतः॥
en: Where is the falling off of that one of excellent character, engaged in offices of beneficence,-more specially with reference to ascetics?

sa: अद्य राममितः क्षिप्रं वनं प्रस्थापयाम्यहम्। यौवराज्येन भरतं क्षिप्रमद्याभिषेचये॥
en: Even this very day will I speedily send Rāma into the forest and without delay install Bharata in the royal heir-apparentship.

sa: स वानरमहाराजः शयानः शरपीडितः। प्रत्युक्तो हेतुमद्वाक्यैर्नोत्तरं प्रतिपद्यत ॥
en: Being thus accosted with reasonable words, that lord, of monkeys, lying on the ground and wounded with shafts, gave no reply.

sa: देवानां दानवानां च ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम्। हितमेव भविष्यद्धि रामप्रव्राजनादिह॥
en: The banishment of Rāma shall surely be for the welfare of the gods and the Asuras and sages of concentrated souls.

sa: स्निग्धगम्भीरघोषेण स्यन्दनेनोपयान् प्रभुः। अयोध्यां भरतः क्षिप्रं प्रविवेश महायशाः॥
en: Arriving by means of a car emitting a low and solemn sound, that lord, the highly famous Bharata speedily entered Ayodhyā.

sa: नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि दण्डकारण्यमाश्रितः॥ चीराजिनधरो धीरो रामो भवतु तापसः। भरतो भजतामद्य यौवराज्यमकण्टकम्॥
en: Let the gentle Rāma, clad in deer-skin, lead the life of a mendicant in the Dandaka forest for the space of nine and five years. And let Bharata gain the heir-apparentship rid of thorns.

sa: ततस्तैः कपिभिर्व्याप्तां दुमहस्तैर्महाबलैः। अपश्यल्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धः किष्किन्धां तां दुरासदाम्।।२६।
en: Thereupon Laksmana, angry, espied the city of Kiskindhă, hard to enter and surrounded by mighty monkeys with trees in their hands.

sa: आदित्य भो लोककृताकृतज्ञ लोकस्य सत्यानृतकर्मसाक्षिन्। मम प्रिया सा क्व गता हृता वा शंसस्व मे शोकहतस्य सर्वम्॥
en: O.Aditya, know you the pious and vicious actions of men; bear you testimony to the truth and untruth of their actions-do you tell me, pray, who am stricken with grief, whither has my dear on repaired, or whether has she been killed?

sa: तस्मात् सुस्राव सरसः सोयोध्यामुपगूहते॥ सरःप्रवृत्ता सरयू: पुण्या ब्रह्मसरश्च्युता।
en: And the stream that issues from that liquid lapse, flows through Ayodhyā: the sacred Sarayü issues from that pool of Brahma.

sa: पिङ्गे पिङ्गाक्षमुख्यस्य बृहती परिमण्डले। चक्षुषी सम्प्रकाशेते चन्द्रसूर्याविव स्थितौ॥
en: And the eyes of that foremost of tawny-hued ones resembled the sun and the moon stationed in a vast yellow aureola.

sa: भगीरथो हि राजर्षिर्दिव्यं स्यन्दनमास्थितः॥ प्रायादग्रे महाराजस्तं गङ्गा पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात्।
en: And stationed on an excellent car that mighty king, the royal saint Bhagiratha, went first, and Gangā went at his back.

sa: न चाहं हरिराज्यस्य प्रभवाम्यङ्गदस्य वा। पितृव्यस्तस्य सुग्रीवः सर्वकार्येष्वनन्तरः॥
en: I cannot myself govern this kingdom nor can I confer it upon Angada. Such duty-devolves upon his (Angada's) uncle Sugrīva now.

sa: पुष्पकं नाम सुश्रोणि भ्रातुर्वैश्रवणस्य मे॥ विमानं सूर्यसंकाशं तरसा निर्जितं रणे। विशालं रमणीयं च तद्विमानं मनोजवम्॥ तत्र सीते मया सार्धं विहरस्व यथासुखम्।
en: O you of shapely hips, the car called Pușpaka, resembling the sun, which (formerly) belonged to my brother Vaiśravaņa, was through my prowess won by me in fight. And vast and beautiful is that car furnished with the speed of the mind. Do you, O Sītā, at your pleasure sport on it along with me.

sa: भूयश्चोर्ध्वं गतिं प्राप्य गिरं तमवलोकयन्। वायुसूनुर्निरालम्बो जगाम कपिकुञ्जरः॥
en: Rising high up and casting his look down on the hill, that foremost of monkeys proceeded by the unsupported aerial track.

sa: स वनं घोरसंकाशं दृष्ट्वा नरवरात्मजः॥ अविप्रहतमैक्ष्वाकः पप्रच्छ मुनिपुङ्गवम्।
en: And beholding a dreadful and trackless. forest, that son of the foremost of men, Ikşvāku's descendant, asked that best of ascetics.

sa: परिगृह्य तु कैकेयी श्वशुरं सुकृतेन मे। मम प्रव्राजनं भर्तुर्भरतस्याभिषेचनम्।७।। द्वावयाचत भर्तारं सत्यसंधं नृपोत्तमम्।
en: Bringing my father-in-law under control by means of her virtuous deeds, Kaikeyi begged, of that truthful, best of monarchs, two boons namely the exile of my husband into woods and the installation of Bharata,

sa: श्रुत्वा तु जामदग्न्यस्य वाक्यं दाशरथिस्तदा। गौरवाद्यन्त्रितकथः पितू राममथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing Jamadagni's, words, the son of Dasaratha, in consideration of the presence of his father, said these words in subdued tone,

sa: अङ्गुल्या न समो रामो मम युद्धे स मानुषः। तव भाग्येन सम्प्राप्तं भजस्व वरवर्णिनि ॥ एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही क्रुद्धा संरक्तलोचना। अब्रवीत् परुषं वाक्यं रहिते राक्षसाधिपम्॥
en: Rāma is a human being and is not even equal to a finger of mine in battle. By your good luck have I come to you-do you give yourself up to me, O you of a beautiful countenance. Being thus addressed by him, Vaidehi exceedingly wroth and with blood-red eyes spoke to that Lord of Rākşasas in the lonely forest, these bold words.

sa: पृथिव्यम्बुचरा राम नानानगनिवासिनः। कोट्योधाश्च इमे प्राप्ता वानरास्तव किंकराः॥
en: O Rāma, these koțis of apes that have arrived, inhabiting earth and water and various mountainous tracts, are at your service.

sa: शूराश्च बलवन्तश्च कृतास्त्राश्च रणाजिरे। कालाभिपन्नाश्च सीदन्ति यथा वालुकसेतवः॥
en: Under the influence of destiny even the mighty heroes, well habited in armours are distressed like to a bridge of sands.

sa: स प्राङ्मुखो राजगृहादभिनिर्याय वीर्यवान्। ततः सुदामां द्युतिमान् संतीर्यावेक्ष्य तां नदीम्॥ ह्रादिनी दूरपारं च प्रत्यक्स्रोतस्तरङ्गिणीम्। शतद्रुमतरच्छीमान् नदीमिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः॥
en: Issuing from the palace, the blazing Bharata endowed with prowess went in an easterly direction, and seeing before him the river called Sudāmā, crossed it. Then the auspicious descendant of Iksvāku crossed the broad Hrādinſ coursing westwards, as also the river Satadru.

sa: एकमेकायने कृच्छ्रे नि:श्वसन्तं मुहुर्मुहुः। समीक्ष्य दुःखितो रामः सौमित्रिमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: And beholding Jațāyu, sigh again and again and breathing with difficulty in a helpless plight, Rāma, highly aggrieved, spoke to Lakşmaņa.

sa: एते वानरमुख्याश्च शतशः शत्रुसूदन। प्राप्ताश्चादाय बलिनः पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्॥
en: These hundreds of prime monkeys, O destroyer of enemies, have come here, bringing with them all the monkeys of the world.

sa: तमप्सरसि हेमायां सक्तं दानवपुङ्गवम्॥ विक्रम्यैवाशनिं गृह्य जघानेशः पुरंदरः।
en: Then he, happening to conceive a passion for an Apsara, Hema (by name), Purandara, vigorously wielding his thunder-bolt, struck him dead.

sa: मन्थरा त्वभ्यसूय्यैनामुत्सृज्याभरणं हि तत्। उवाचेदं ततो वाक्यं कोपदुःखसमन्विता॥
en: Mantharā, making Kaikeyi the object of her wrath, threw off the noble ornament, and spoke these words, in anger and grief.

sa: त्वत्तोऽहं वधमाकासन् वार्यमाणोऽपि तारया॥ सुग्रीवेण सह भ्रात्रा द्वन्द्वयुद्धमुपागतः।
en: Desiring to have my destruction brought about by you, I entered into conflict with my brother Sugrīva, albeit prevented by Târā.

sa: खरस्त्रिशिरसा तेन मृत्युलोभात् प्रसादितः। गच्छ युध्येत्यनुज्ञातो राघवाभिमुखो ययौ॥
en: Thus satisfied by Trisirā, from his desire to meet with death, the latter, on being permitted with Go, proceeded towards Rāma.

sa: महाविघ्नः प्रवृत्तोऽयं दक्षिणामास्थितो दिशम्। दिशमन्यां प्रपत्स्यामस्तत्र तप्स्यामहे तपः॥
en: A mighty disturbance has happened in regard to the southern quarter: let us therefore repairing to another region, carry on austerities.

sa: अन्नं हि विधिवत्स्वादु प्रशंसन्ति द्विजर्षभाः। अहो तृप्ताः स्म भद्रं ते इति शुश्राव राघवः॥
en: The foremost regenerate ones said, The viands have been prepared in the prescribed form, and they taste excellent. We have been gratified. God bless you! All this was heard by the descendant of Raghu.

sa: पुत्रो दशरथस्यायं महाराजस्य धीमतः। निदेशं पालयत्वेनं गङ्गे त्वदभिरक्षितः॥
en: O Ganga, protected by you, may the son of the intelligent and mighty monarch, Dasaratha, execute the mandate (of the latter.)

sa: अहं हि पुरुषव्याघ्रावपश्यन् रामलक्ष्मणौ। केन शक्तिप्रभावेण राज्यं रक्षितुमुत्सहे॥
en: Not seeing those chiefs of men, Rāma and Lakşmaņa, by virtue of whose energy can I venture to rule the kingdom?

sa: तत्र कश्चिन्मया दृष्टः सूर्योदयसमप्रभाम्। स्त्रियमादाय गच्छन् वै भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमः॥
en: There I saw somebody resembling a mass of crushed collyrium, going away, taking a female resembling the rising sun in splendour.

sa: दनुस्त्वजनयत् पुत्रमश्वग्रीवमरिंदम ॥ नरकं कालकं चैव कालकापि व्यजायत।
en: And, O vanquisher of your foes, Danu gave birth to a son, named, Ašvagriva. And Kālikā brought forth Naraka and Kālaka.

sa: एवं कथयमानः स ददर्शाश्रममण्डलम्। कुशचीरपरिक्षिप्तं ब्राह्मया लक्ष्म्या समावृतम्॥
en: Thus conversing, Rāma saw the collection of asylums, strewn with Kusa and bark, and be-girt with energy derived from Brahmā lore.

sa: स हि देशस्तु वध्यस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। राक्षसाधिपतेर्वासः सहस्राक्षसमद्युतेः॥
en: That country belongs to the impious Rāvana, worthy of being slain—the lord of Raksasas, like to the thousand-eyed (deity) in splendour.

sa: तत्र वैदूर्यवर्णाभो वज्रसंस्थानसंस्थितः। नानागुमलताकीर्णो वज्रो नाम महागिरिः॥ श्रीमान् समुदितस्तत्र योजनानां शतं समम्। गुहास्तत्र विचेतव्या प्रयत्नेन प्लवङ्गमाः॥
en: There, in hue like lapises, abounding in various kinds of trees and plants, is a mighty hill of an adamantine basis, called Vajra; beautiful, famous, and measuring an hundred Yojanas in height and area. There let the monkeys carefully explore the caves.

sa: ततश्चर्य रम्येषु फलार्थी गिरिसानुषु। ददर्श पर्युपावृत्तो लक्ष्मीवाल्लँक्ष्मणोऽग्रजम् ॥
en: And the graceful Lakşmaņa, returning from the picturesque mountain-summits where he had sojourned in quest of fruits, beheld his elder brother.

sa: इतीव विलपन्तीं तां प्रोवाच रघुनन्दनः। सीते तत्र भवांस्तातः प्रव्राजयति मां वनम्॥ कुले महति सम्भूते धर्मज्ञे धर्मचारिणि। शृणु जानकि येनेदं क्रमेणाद्यागतं मम॥
en: Whereupon spoke to that weeping Sītā, the descendant of Raghu thus:, Oh Sītā, Oh you born of a great family, versed in the knowledge of religion and intent on the performance of religious rites, my father has banished me to the forest! Do you hear, Oh daughter of Janaka, how has this calamity befallen me.

sa: कुम्भकर्णस्य निधनं मेघनादनिबर्हणम्। रावणस्य विनाशं च सीतावाप्तिमरेः पुरे॥
en: And the killing of Kumbhakarna and Meghanāda; and the destruction of Răvaņa, and the recovery of Sītā in the enemy's city.

sa: तव चैव गुणैर्बद्धस्त्ववियोगान्महीपतिः। राजा देवत्वमापन्नो भरतस्य यथा श्रुतम्॥
en: As I have heard from Bharata, king Dasaratha died for your separation, attached as he was to you for your accomplishments.

sa: तमतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्र महेन्द्रपरिपालितम्। षष्टिं गिरिसहस्राणि काञ्चनानि गमिष्यथ॥ तरुणादित्यवर्णानि भ्राजमानानि सर्वशः। जातरूपमयैर्वृक्षैः शोभितानि सुपुष्पितैः॥
en: Having passed by that mountain protected by Mahendra, you shall repair to sixty thousand hills of gold; in hue like the infant sun, and blazing on all sides and embellished by blossoming golden trees,

sa: स याच्यमानः काकुत्स्थस्ताभिः प्रकृतिभिस्तदा। कुर्वाणः पितरं सत्यं वनमेवान्वपद्यत॥
en: Although besought by the subjects, the truthful Käkutstha having pledged his word to his father, kept on going to the forest.

sa: उदितां मरणे बुद्धिं मुनिवाक्यैर्निवर्तये। बुद्धिर्या तेन मे दत्ता प्राणानां रक्षणे मम॥ सा मेऽपनयते दुःखं दीप्तेवाग्निशिखा तमः।
en: My rising intention of doing away with myself I have suppressed in consideration of the words of the ascetic. The reason which he had imparted to me for preserving my life, has removed my pains even as a flaming fire (dispels darkness).

sa: उपपन्नमिदं वाक्यं यस्त्वमेवमभाषथाः। जातः पुत्रो दशरथात् कैकेय्यां राजसत्तमात्॥
en: Having been born as a son to Daśaratha, foremost of monarchs, by Kaikeyſ, this speech of yours is worthy of you.

sa: ततस्तु सीतामभिवाद्य लक्ष्मण: कृताञ्जलिः किचिदभिप्रणम्य। अवेक्षमाणो बहुशः स मैथिली जगाम रामस्य समीपमात्मवान् ॥
en: Afterwards the pure-hearted Laksmana, having control over his senses, saluting Sītā with clasped palms and bending low a little proceeded where Rāma was, casting again and again his glance upon her as he went.

sa: संदिश्य राक्षसान् घोरान् रावणोऽष्टौ महाबलान्। आत्मानं बुद्धिवैक्लव्यात् कृतकृत्यममन्यत॥
en: Having commissioned those eight terrible and mighty Rākşasas, Rāvana, in consequence of perversion of sense, considered himself as crowned with success.

sa: ऋष्यशृङ्गं पुरस्कृत्य कर्म चकुर्द्विजर्षभाः। अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे राज्ञोऽस्य सुमहात्मनः॥
en: And with Rşyasſága at their head, the principal twice-born ones began the proceedings in that mighty horse-sacrifice of that high-souled monarch.

sa: जलप्रपातैरुद्भेदैनिष्पन्दैश्च क्वचित् क्वचित्। स्रवद्भिर्भात्ययं शैलः स्रवन्मद इव द्विपः॥
en: And like an elephant dropping the temporal juice, this hill appears beautiful with cascades, fountains and riles, flowing here and there.

sa: मद्दोषकृतदोषां तां यथा तारां तपस्विनीम्। सुग्रीवो नावमन्येत तथावस्थातुमर्हसि॥
en: It behoveth you to so arrange as Sugrīva may not disregard that chaste Tārā who is blameable for my folly only.

sa: रामस्य त्वन्तरं प्रेप्सुर्दशग्रीवस्तदन्तरे॥ उपतस्थे च वैदेही भिक्षुरूपेण रावणः।
en: In the mean time the Ten-necked Rävana, enquiring about Rāma's weak points appeared before Vaidehī in the guise of a mendicant.

sa: असत्यशीला विकृता दुर्गा अहृदयाः सदा। असत्यः पापसंकल्पाः क्षणमात्रविरागिणः॥
en: Those women that are untruthful, unmindful, of evil ways heartless, intent on unrighteous acts, and whose love is evanescent. are unchaste.

sa: वीक्षमाणस्तु मन्दासुः सर्वतो मन्दमुच्छ्वसन्। आदावेव तु सुग्रीवं ददर्शानुजमग्रतः॥
en: Vāli, ranging on the verge of death, casting his looks arounds and sighing faintly, espied his younger brother Sugrīva before him.

sa: सुषेणस्तु महातेजाः सत्त्ववान् कपिसत्तमः। अशीतिं प्रतिजानेऽहं योजनानां पराक्रमे॥
en: And the highly powerful Suşena, possessed of strength-foremost of monkeys said—I declare that in motion I am equal to eighty Yojanas.

sa: स्यन्दनांस्तुरगोपेतान् सूतमुख्यैरधिष्ठितान्। एतान् सम्पततः शीघ्रं पश्य शत्रुघ्न कानने॥
en: And, O Satrughna, see how fast these cars yoked with steeds and driven by skilful charioteers, are proceeding in the forest.

sa: तस्य वानरसिंहस्य प्लवमानस्य सागरम्। कक्षान्तरगतो वायुर्जीमूत इव गर्जति॥
en: The wind that had got into the armpits of that leonine monkey who was crossing over the main, roar like clouds.

sa: राज्यहेतोः स चेद् भ्राता भ्रात्राक्रूरेण पातितः। रामेण प्रसृतैर्दूरान्मार्गणैर्दूरपातिभिः॥
en: Hath Vāli been killed by Rāma, waiting at a distance with fleet and distant-coursing shafts, being requested by Sugrīva for kingdom?

sa: सशरीरस्य भद्रं वस्त्रिशङ्कोरस्य भूपतेः। आरोहणं प्रतिज्ञातं नानृतं कर्तुमुत्सहे॥
en: Good betide you, I have vowed to this king, Trišanku's bodily ascension unto heaven, therefore, I dare not falsify my vow.

sa: स तां रत्नमयीं दिव्यां श्रीमान् पुष्पितकाननाम्। रम्यां रत्नसमाकीर्णां ददर्श महतीं गुहाम्॥ हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधां नानारत्नोपशोभिताम् सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभिताम्॥ देवगन्धर्वपुत्रैश्च वानरैः कामरूपिभिः। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरैः शोभितां प्रियदर्शनैः॥
en: The graceful Lakşmaņa espied that huge picturesque and celestial cave adorned with jewels and flowery gardens. It was filled with palatial buildings, various jewels and flowery trees, producing at all times wished for fruits. It was beautified with good-looking monkeyschildren of the celestials and Gandharabas wearing celestial garlands and clothes and assuming shapes at will.

sa: प्रसादये त्वां धर्मज्ञ सुग्रीवार्थं समाहिता। महान् रोषसमुत्पन्नः संरम्भस्त्यज्यतामयम्॥
en: I crave your favour with concentrated mind, O you that know morality. Renounce the mighty grief that springs from your ire.

sa: अवेक्ष्याञ्जलिपानांश्च ब्राह्मणान् वेदपारगान्। ययुर्मध्येन बाह्रीकान् सुदामानं च पर्वतम्॥
en: Beholding here Brāhmaṇas versed in the Vedas drinking water with their joined hands, they went through Vahllika towards the mount Sudaman.

sa: अरिष्टनेमिनः पुत्रो वैनतेयो महाबलः। गरुत्मानिव विख्यात उत्तमः सर्वपक्षिणाम्॥
en: Aristanemi's son the mighty Vainateya,* famous by the cognomen of Garutmā, is the foremost of birds. *Offspring of Vinatā, Garura's mother.

sa: विषये वासवस्तस्य सम्यगेव प्रवर्षति। रत्नैर्धनैश्च पशुभिः सस्येश्चापि पृथग्विधैः॥
en: The cities and the kingdom of this king were filled with wealth and gems and cattle and various sorts of grain.

sa: अभिमानो मृघावादो लोभो मोहस्तथाक्षमा। लिङ्गानि रजसस्तानि वर्तन्ते हेत्वहेतुतः॥
en: Pride, false speech, cupidity, stupefaction, vindictiveness, whether originating from any known cause or otherwise, are characteristics of the quality of darkness.

sa: धारयामास देवेशो हस्तैर्यज्ञपतिस्तदा। तं प्रसन्नं प्रसन्नात्मा नारदो द्विजसत्तमः॥
en: With a cheerful heart, that foremost of twice-born one viz., Narada, controlling speech, bowed to the great God and worshipped Him.

sa: एतद् बुद्ध्वा भवेद् बुद्धः किमन्यद् बुद्धलक्षणम्। विज्ञायैतद् विमुच्यन्ते कृतकृत्या मनीषिणः॥ न भवति विदुषां महद्भयं यदविदुषा समुहद्भयं परत्र। न हि गतिरधिकास्ति कस्यचिद् भवति हि या विदुषः सनातनी॥
en: By gaining such knowledge one really becomes learned. What else is the mark of a person of knowledge? Having gained such knowledge, the wise men consider themselves successful and become liberated. Those things which produce fear to men shorn of knowledge do not do so to those who are gifted with knowledge. There is no end higher than the eternal end which is acquired by a learned person.

sa: गृहस्थश्चावजेष्यामि मृत्युमित्येव स प्रभो। प्रतिज्ञामकरोद् धीमान् दीप्ततेजा विशाम्पते।॥
en: This intelligent prince of fiery energy took the vow, O lord, of conquering Death by leading the life of a householder.

sa: भीष्म उवाच आसीत् किल नरश्रेष्ठ महापद्ये पुरोत्तमे। गङ्गाया दक्षिणे तीरे कश्चिद् विप्रः समाहितः।
en: Bhishma said "In a beautiful town called by the name of Mahapadma which was situate on the southern side of the river Ganga, there lived, O best of men, a Brahmana of concentrated Soul.

sa: तादृग्रूपा न नारीषु भूतपूर्वा युधिष्ठिर। दुर्योधनसुता यादृगभवद् वरवर्णिनी॥
en: No woman, O Yudhishthira, had been born before, who was so very beautiful as that excellent lady the daughter of Duryodhana.

sa: तदेतच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि नानात्वैकत्वदर्शनम्। बुद्धं चाप्रतिबुद्धं च बुध्यमानं च तत्त्वतः॥ विद्याविद्ये च भगवान्नक्षरं क्षरमेव च। साङ्ख्यं योगं च कार्येन पृथक् चैवापृथक् च ह॥
en: I, therefore, wish to hear you once more discourse to me on those subjects of unity and multiplicity, on him who is gifted with knowledge, on what is shorn of knowledge, on Individual Soul, Knowledge, Ignorance, on Indestructible, Destructible, and the Sankhya and the Yoga systems, in detail and separately and agreeable to the truth.

sa: यांस्तु गन्धान् रसान् वापि ब्रह्मचारी न सेवते॥ सेवेत तान् समावृत्य इति धर्मेषु निश्चयः।
en: What scents or tastes the Brahmacharin may abstain from while actually leading a life of celebacy may be used by him after his return from the preceptor's house. This is according to the ordinance.

sa: गौतमश्चापि सम्प्राप्य पुनस्तं शबरालयम्। शूद्रायां जनयामास पुत्रान् दुष्कृतकारिणः॥
en: Gautama also, coming back to his home in the village of the hunters, begot many sinful children upon his Shudra wife.

sa: अनुषत्तु द्वयेनैते भावाः स्थावरजङ्गमाः। न मृत्युसेनामायान्तीं जातु कश्चित् प्रबाधते॥ बलात् सत्यमृते त्वेकं सत्ये ह्यमृतमाश्रितम्। मृत्योर्वा गृहमेतद् वै या ग्रामे वसतो रतिः॥
en: All forms of existence, mobile and immobile, are possessed by these two. When the soldiers, which constitute Death's army, march, nothing can resist them except that one thing, viz., the power of Truth, for in Truth alone Immortality lives. The joy which one feels of living in the midst of men is residence of Death.

sa: जितकाशिनि शूरे च संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिनि। निवसामि मनुष्येन्द्रे सदैव बलसूदन।॥
en: I always live, O killer of Vala, with those foremost of men, the heroes longing for victory and unretrcating from battle.

sa: भानुवत् प्रयात्यस्तं यावच्च विमला दिशः। तावदेनं परित्यज्य प्रेतकार्याण्युपासत॥
en: Throwing away the body, perform those rites before the sun sets and before the points of compass are covered with darkness.

sa: भरणाद्धि स्त्रियो भर्ता पालनाद्धि पतिस्तथा। गुणस्यास्य निवृत्तौ तु न भर्ता न पुनः पतिः॥
en: The husband, because he maintains the wife, is called Bharta, and he is called Pati, because he protects her. When he fails to discharge these two functions, he ceases to both Bhartri and Pati.

sa: न हि खल्वनुपायेन कश्चिदर्थोऽभिसिद्ध्यति। सूत्रजालैर्यथा मत्स्यान् बनन्ति जलजीविनः॥
en: Verily, an object cannot be performed without the application of means. Fishermen catch fish by means of nets made of strings.

sa: तुलाधार उवाच सद्भिर्वा यदि वासद्भिः पन्थानमिमतास्थितम्। प्रत्यक्षं क्रियतां साधु ततो ज्ञास्यसि तद् यथा॥
en: Tuladhara said See with your own eyes, O Jajali, who, amongst the good or otherwise, have followed this path of duty which I have spoken of! You will understand properly how the truth stands.

sa: तेन ह्यमितवीर्येण वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः। हतं पुत्रशतं सद्यस्तपसाऽपि पितामह॥
en: O Sire, by virtue of his austerities that powerful man destroyed in a moment the hundred sons of the great Vasishtha.

sa: यदा बकपती राजन् ब्रह्माणं नोपसर्पति। ततो रोषादिदं प्राह खगेन्द्राय पितामहः॥ यस्मान्मूढो मम सभां नागतोऽसौ बकाधमः। तस्माद् वधं स दुष्टात्मा नचिरात् समवाप्स्यति॥
en: Addressing the king he said, Once on a time, O monarch, this prince of cranes did not come to the region of Brahman when he was required. In anger the Grandfather said to this prince of birds,Since this vile crane has not come to-day in my assembly, therefore, that wicked one shall not soon die.

sa: ततः स भगवान् रुद्रो महर्षिजनसंस्तुतः॥ प्रगृह्यासिममेयात्मा रूपमन्यच्चकार ह।
en: At this, the divine and great Rudra, praised by the great Rishis, took up that sword and assumed a different forin.

sa: शुभाशुभं कर्म समीरितं यत् प्रवर्तते सर्वलोकेषु किञ्चित्। तस्मादृषेस्तद्भवतीति विद्याद् दिव्यन्तरिक्षे भुवि चाप्सु चेति॥
en: You should know that whatever acts, good or bad, laid down in the Vedas and occurring in heaven and Earth, the sky between, and the waters, are all made by that ancient Rishi Narayana.

sa: इन्द्रियाणां प्रसङ्गेन दोषमृच्छत्यसंशयम्। संनियम्य तु तान्येव सिद्धिमाप्नोति मानवः॥
en: Forsooth, one incurs fault by letting loose his senses. It is only by controlling them that one succeeds in acquiring success.

sa: अतुष्टिः परितापश्च शोको लोभस्तथाक्षमा। लिङ्गानि रजसस्तानि दृश्यन्ते हेत्वहेतुभिः॥
en: Discontent, heart-burning, grief, cupidity, vindictiveness, are all marks of darkness. They are seen with or without sufficient causes for producing them.

sa: श्रीरुवाच स्थास्यामि नित्यं देवेन्द्र यथा त्वयि निबोध तत्। विधिना वेददृष्टेन चतुर्धा विभजस्व माम्॥
en: Shree said four parts 'O King of the deities, I shall tell you as to how I may be entitled to live in you perpetually. Divide me into four according to the Vedic injunction.'

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच रमे जपन् महाभाग किं लोकैः सनातनैः। सशरीरेण गन्तव्यं मया स्वर्गं न वा विभो॥ नु
en: The Brahmana said O highly-blessed one, I take great pleasure in recitation. What necessity have I for those eternal regions of which you speak? Indeed, O powerful lord, I do not wish to go to heaven even with this body of mine.

sa: भवन्तं स्वजनादस्मि सम्प्राप्तं श्रुतवानहम्। अतस्त्वां स्वयमेवाहं द्रष्टुमभ्यागतो द्विज॥
en: Having heard from any wife that you are here, I have to come this spot, O twice-born one, for seeing you!

sa: न शौचमनुरुद्ध्यन्त तेषां सूदजनास्तथा। मनसा कर्मणा वाचा भक्ष्यमासीदनावृतम्॥
en: Their cooks no longer cherished any consideration for purity of mind, deed, and word. They ate what had been left uncovered.

sa: उद्यन् हि सविता यद्वत्सृजते रश्मिमण्डलम्। स एवास्तमपागच्छंस्तदेवात्मनि यच्छति॥
en: The Sun rising spreads his rays. When he sets, he withdraws to himself those very rays that were spread by him.

sa: वर्तयत्येव पितरि पुत्रः प्रभवते तथा। अमित्रभृत्यतां प्राप्य ख्यापयन्त्यनपत्रपाः॥
en: In the presence of fathers, sons began to exercise power. Not receiving wages persons accepted service and shamelessly proclaimed the fact.

sa: इत्येतद् बलिना गीतमनहंकारसंज्ञितम्। वाक्यं श्रुत्वा सहस्राक्षः खमेवारुरुहे तदा॥
en: After having listened to the wrong of Vali which were marked by no pride, the thousandeyed Indra then ascended the skies.

sa: आहूयैनान् महाब्रह्मन् विशमानांस्ततस्ततः। पश्येमान् हस्तपादैश्च श्लिष्टान् देहेषु सर्वशः॥
en: See, O Brahmana, those birds have got their wings and legs for entering their respective nests. Call them, O twice-born one.

sa: तस्याप्येवंप्रभावस्य सदश्वस्येव धावतः। अजस्रं सर्वलोकस्य कः कुतो वा न वा कुतः॥ कस्येदं कस्य वा नेदं कुतो वेदं न वा कुतः। सम्बन्धः कोऽस्ति भूतानां स्वैरप्यवयवैरिह॥
en: When such is the state of the bodies of all creatures,-i.e., when what is called the body is changing continually like the rapid motion of a house of good mettle,-who then has come whence or not whence, or whose is it or whose is it not, or whence does it not arise? What connection does there exist between creatures and their own bodies?

sa: अष्टवक्र उवाच तथास्तु साधयिष्यामि तत्र यास्याम्यसंशयम्। यत्र त्वं तदसे साधो भवान् भवतु सत्यवाक्॥
en: Ashtavakra said So be it! I shall do your bidding. Verily, I shall proceed to that region of which you mention, O you righteous soul! On your side, you should make your words truthful.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अथ काले बहुतिथे पूर्णे प्राप्तो भुजङ्गमः। दत्ताभ्यनुज्ञः स्वं वेश्म कृतकर्मा विवस्वता॥
en: Bhishma said Upon the expire of full fifteen days, the Naga king (Padmanabha), having finished his task of dragging the car of the Sun and obtained the latter's permission, returned to his own house.

sa: श्रेयः पुष्पफलं काष्ठात् कामो धर्मार्थयोर्वरः॥ पुष्पतो मध्विव रसः काम आभ्यां तथा स्मृतः। कामो धर्मार्थयोर्योनिः कामश्चाथ तदात्मकः॥
en: Flowers and fruits are better than wood. Likewise, Desire is better than Virtue and Profit. As honey is extracted from flowers, so is desire from these two. Desire is the father of Virtue and profit. Desire is the soul of these two.

sa: क्षेत्राणि हि शरीराणि बीजं चापि शुभाशुभम्। तानि वेत्ति स योगात्मा ततः क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते॥
en: Kshetriya is another name for body. And because he knows all bodies as also all good and bad acts, therefore, he, who is the soul of Yoga, is called by the name of Kshetrajna.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आनृशंस्यं विजानामि दर्शनेन सतां सदा। नृशंसान्न विजानामि तेषां कर्म च भारत॥
en: Yudhishthira said I know what benevolence is, because I have always marked the conduct of good people. I de not, however, know them who are malevolent, nor the nature of their deeds, O Bharata.

sa: कृतवान् यानि रूपाणि कथितानि दिवौकसैः॥ अनुग्रहार्थं विप्राणां शृणु वत्स समासतः। तानि ते कीर्तयिष्यामि यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
en: For showing a favour to the Brahmanas, the dwellers of heaven have recited for their information the various forins which were assumed by Mahadeva in days of yore. You have asked me about these. I shall recite them to you, O) son.

sa: एष धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ प्रोक्तः पापो मया तव। मित्रद्रोही कृतघ्नो वै किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: I have thus told you, O foremost of all virtuous men the characteristics of a sinful wretch who is stained by ingratitude and who injures his friend. What else do you wish to hear.

sa: ओंकाररथमारुह्य ते विशन्ति महेश्वरम्। अयं स देवयानानामादिते द्वारमुच्यते॥
en: Riding on the car of OM, those men enter inter into Maheshvara. You are the solar door of the celestial road.

sa: इत्युक्तवचने तस्मिन् राक्षसेन्द्रे महात्मनि। यथेष्टं तानि रत्नानि जगृहुर्ब्राह्मणर्षभाः॥
en: When these words were uttered by the great Rakshasa chief, those foremost of Brahmanas, took as much wealth as each desired.

sa: न भूतो न भविष्योऽस्ति न च धर्मोऽस्ति कश्चन। योऽभयः सर्वभूतानां स प्राप्नोत्यभयं पदम्॥
en: There is no past, no future, There is no morality or virtue. He who is not an object of fear with any creature acquires a state in which there is no fear. or or

sa: सोऽहं कथं प्रतीक्षिष्ये जालेनापिहितश्चरन्॥ राज्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायामायुरल्पतरं यदा।
en: When passing away, each succeed-night lessens the lease of human life, the wise man should consider the day to be fruitless.

sa: तस्याः पुत्रत्वमागम्य स्त्रियाः स पिबति स्तनौ। ततः स कापिलेयत्वं लेभे बुद्धिं च नैष्ठिकीम्॥
en: Panchashikha was accepted by her as a son and he used to suck her breasts. For this, he came to be known as the son of Kapila and his understanding became fixed on Brahma.

sa: पापाचार: पापकर्मा पापात्मा पापसाधनः॥ हन्तव्योऽयं मम मतिर्भवद्भिरिति राक्षसाः। इत्युक्ता राक्षसेन्द्रेण राक्षसा घोरविक्रमा:।१९॥ नैच्छन्त तं भक्षयितुं पापकर्माणमित्युत।
en: Of sinful decds, of sinful habits, of sinful soul, and used to sin, this wretch, I think, should be killed by you!—Thus addressed by the Rakshasa king, many Rakshasas of dreadful prowess cxpressed their reluctance to eat the flesh of that sinner.

sa: साङ्गानावर्तयन् वेदांस्तपस्तेपे सुदुश्चरम्। यद् ब्रह्मा ऋषयश्चैव स्वयं पशुपतिश्च यत्॥ शेषाश्च विबुधश्रेष्ठा दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः। नागाः सुपर्णा गन्धर्वाः सिद्धा राजर्षयश्च ये॥ हव्यं कव्यं च सततं विधियुक्तं प्रयुञ्जते। कृत्स्नं तु तस्य देवस्य चरणावुपतिष्ठति॥
en: Reciting the Vedas with their branches, he is practising the severest austerities. Whatever libations of clarified butter or meat are poured on the sacrificial fire according to the ordinances of Brahman, by the Rishis, by Pashupati himself, by the rest of the principal gods, by the Daityas, the Danavas, and the Rakshasas, Nagas, Garuda bird, Gandharvas, Siddhas and foremost of the sages and whatever sacrificial oblation are offered, all reach the feet of that great god.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना स शूद्रोऽचिन्तयन्नृप। कथमत्र मया कार्यं श्रद्धा धर्मपरा च मे॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the ascetic, the Shudra began to think in his mind, o king How should I now act? I have great reverence for those religious duties which lead to merit.

sa: तुष्टाव च महायोगी देवं तत्रस्थ एव च। नि:सारं काङ्क्षमाणः स तेन स्म प्रतिहन्यते॥
en: The great ascetic began to sing the praises of the god from where he was desirous of finding on outlet for escape. But, having stopped all his outlets, Rudra, prevented him from coming out.

sa: ततः शुकेति दीर्पण शब्देनाक्रन्दितस्तदा॥ स्वयं पित्रा स्वरेणोच्चैस्त्रील्लोकाननुनाद्य वै।
en: Vyasa, however, began to lament, loudly naming his son and causing the three worlds to resound with the noise he made.

sa: ये खल्वजिह्वाः कृपणा अल्पप्राणा अपाणयः। सहन्ते तानि दुःखानि दिष्ट्या त्वं न तथा. मुने॥
en: Those living creatures that are without tongues, that are helpless, that have little strength, and that have no hands, suffer all kinds of misery. By good luck, O ascetic, you are not like them.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततो वृक्षौषधितृणमेवमुक्तं महात्मना। ब्रह्माणमभिसम्पूज्य जगामाशु यथागतम्॥
en: Thus addressed by the great Brahman, the trees, herbs and grasses worshipped the Creator and then went away without waiting there.

sa: इति सम्यङ्मनस्यते बहवः सन्ति हेतवः। एतदस्तीदमस्तीति न किञ्चित्प्रतिदृश्यते॥
en: Thus various sorts of speculations arise in the mind. Nothing can settle whether this opinion is right or that is right.

sa: समागम्य स तेनाथ पूजांचक्रे यथाविधि। ब्राह्मणः कुण्डधारस्य विस्मितश्चाभवन्नृप॥
en: Meeting with him the Brahmana offered him adorations according to the observances ordained. The Brahmana, however, felt some surprise, O king.

sa: पिता पितामहश्चैव तथैव प्रपितामहः। अहमेवात्र विज्ञेयस्त्रिषु पिण्डेषु संस्थितः॥
en: I am the father, the grandfather and the great grandfather, and I should be considered as living in these three Pindas.

sa: अपान्तरतमाश्चैव वेदाचार्यः स उच्यते। प्राचीनगर्भ तमृषि प्रवदन्तीह केचन॥
en: The Rishi Apantaratamas is said to be the preceptor of the Vedas, some call that Rishi by the name of Prachina-garbha.

sa: अस्तुवन् विविधैः स्तोत्रैर्महादेवं सुरास्तदा। ब्रह्मा भवं तदाऽस्तौषीद् रथन्तरमुदीरयन्॥
en: The gods were engaged in singing the praises of Mahadeva in various hymns. The Grandfather Brahman, uttering a Rathantara, landed Mahadeva.

sa: यदिदं सप्तमं जन्म पद्मजं ब्रह्मणो नृप। तत्रैव धर्मः कथितः स्वयं नारायणेन ह॥ पितामहाय शुद्धाय युगादौ लोकधारिणे। पितामहश्च दक्षाय धर्ममेतं पुरा ददौ॥
en: During the seventh birth of Brahman from the lotus, O king, that sprang from the navel of Narayana, this religion was once more preached by Narayana himself, to the Grandsire of pure soul, the Creator of all the worlds, in the beginning of this Kalpa. The Grandfather gave it in days of yore to Daksha.

sa: तत्र चाजायत तदा पुरुषः पुरुषर्षभ॥ ह्रस्वोऽतिमात्रं रक्ताक्षो हरिश्मश्रुर्विभीषणः।
en: From that fire came out a dreadful being, O king of very short stature, having blood-red cyes and a green beard.

sa: बृहच्चैवमिदं शास्त्रमित्याहुर्विदुषो जनाः। अस्मिश्च शास्त्रे योगानां पुनर्वेदे पुरःसरः॥
en: The learned say that this Sankhya System is very extensive. Yogins have respect for that System as also for the Vedas.

sa: श्वः शिरः श्रोष्यसे तस्य सैन्धवस्य रणे हृतम्। समन्तपञ्चकाद् बाह्यं विशोका भव मा रुंदः॥
en: Tomorrow you shall hear that the head of the Sindhu ruler has been severed from his trunk in battle, to roll on the precincts of the Samantapanchaka. Dismiss your grief and do not weep.

sa: प्रपतन्त स्म वीरास्ते विरेजुर्भरतर्षभ। वसन्ते पुष्पशबलाश्शूताः प्रपतिता इव॥
en: When falling, these heroes, O scion of the Bharata race, appeared beautiful like blossoming mango trees falling down in the spring.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नेन सहितो महत्या सेनयावृतः। केकया भ्रातरः पञ्च वामपार्श्व समाश्रिताः॥ धृष्टकेतुर्नरव्याघ्रश्चेकितानश्च वीर्यवान्। दक्षिणं पक्षमाश्रित्य स्थितौ व्यूहस्य रक्षणे॥
en: The five Kaikeya brothers, united with Dhrishtadyumna and supported by a mighty division, stationed themselves on its left wing. Dhrishtaketu the foremost of men and Chekitana endued with prowess, stationing themselves on the right wing, prepared themselves for the defence of array.

sa: दृष्ट्वा विनिहतौ संख्ये मातुलावपलायिनौ। भृशं मुमुचुरश्रूणि पुत्रास्तव विशाम्पते॥
en: Thereafter, O ruler of men, your sons beholding their two unretreating and heroic maternal uncles slain, began unceasingly to discharge weapons.

sa: अभ्यवर्षच्छरौघेण कौरवाणामनीकिनीम्। सा हन्यमाना पार्थेन तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनी॥
en: Poured showers of arrows on the host of the Kauravas. Then that army of your son, thus smashed by Pritha's son.

sa: रथसंघांस्तथा नागान् हयांश्च हयासादिभिः। पादातांश्च सुसंक्रुद्धः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Then, O king the elephant careered, hither and thither, and crushed divisions of cars and elephants and horses mounted by cavalrysoldiers.

sa: सात्यकिस्तु ततस्तूर्णं भीष्ममासाद्य संयुगे। आकर्णप्रहितैस्तीक्ष्णैनिशितैस्तिग्मतेजनैः।। :॥ शरैर्बहुभिरानछेत् पितरं ते जनेश्वर। ततः संधाय वै तीक्ष्णं शरं परमदारुणम्॥
en: Thereupon, speedily rushing at Bhishma, Satyaki in that encounter, with numerous keen pointed and sharp edged shafts discharged with a bow-string drawn back to the ear, pierced, O ruler of men your own father. Thereat aiming a sharp and very dreadful arrow.

sa: विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ क्षेमधूर्तिश्च वीर्यवान्। त्रयाणां तव पुत्राणां त्रय एवानुयायिनः॥
en: The two princes from Avanti, viz., Vinda and Anuvinda and the highly puissant Kshemadhurti were the followers of your three sons,

sa: ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः। तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम्॥
en: To those who have destroyed this ignorance by the knowledge of Self, this knowledge like the Sun shows forth the Supreme.

sa: सविद्ध्वा दशभिर्बाणैः साश्वयन्तारमा निम्। उदक्रोशन्महाशब्दं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: He shot ten arrows, injured Abhimanyu with horses and charioteer killed, challenge in a loud voice and said-O! stay there undeviated.

sa: ततः समभवद् युद्धं घोररूपं भयानकम्। पाण्डूनां भगदत्तेन यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम्॥
en: Then ensued a dreadful combat of awful aspect, between the Pandava hosts and Bhagadatta's divisions, increasing the population of Death's domain.

sa: षष्टिनागसहस्राणि षष्टिनागशतानि च। सौवर्णानकरोद् राजा ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च तान् ददौ॥
en: The king caused sixty-six thousands images of elephants to be made of gold and he gave them away to the Brahmanas.

sa: अङ्गिराः प्राह पुत्रस्य मन्त्रज्ञस्य बृहस्पतेः। बृहस्पतिरथोवाच अग्निवेश्याय धीमते॥
en: Angiras again gave those Mantras to Brihaspati his son conversant with all Mantras. Brihaspati next imparted them to the intelligent Agniveshya.

sa: अक्रुद्ध्यत महाकायो भीमसेनिर्घटोत्कचः। प्रादुश्चक्रे ततो माया घोररूपां सुदारुणाम्॥
en: The huge-bodied Ghatotkacha, the son of Bhimasena became wrought up with rage, and brought into existence an awful and terrible illusion.

sa: तथैव पार्षतं शूरं शल्यः समितिशोभनः। आजधानोरसि क्रुद्धस्ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Similarly, Shalya also, that beautifier of an assembly, angrily wounded Prishata's heroic son on the breast. Thereupon there commenced another battle.

sa: स्वयं दुर्योधनो राजा पार्षतं समुपाद्रवत्। नकुलः सहदेवश्च मद्रराजनमीयतुः॥
en: King Duryodhana, himself rushed against the son of Prishata; the twins Nakula and Sahadeva proceeded against the king of the Madras.

sa: कृपां कुरु महाबाहो मयि धर्मभृतां वर। त्वं हि सत्यव्रतो वीर पृथिव्यामित नः श्रुतम्॥
en: Act towards me with kindness, O you of long arms, O foremost among the supporters of virtue. It has been heard by us that you are a hero of truthful vows in this world.

sa: एह्येहि वसुधे क्षिप्रं क्षरैभ्यः काक्षितं पयः। ततो दास्यामि भद्रं ते अन्नं यस्य यथेप्सितम्॥
en: "Come, come, O Earth, quickly give these my subjects the milk they desire. Good betide you; from the milk you shall shed, I desire to give my subjects the edibles they wish to have.

sa: तान् प्रत्यगृह्णादव्यग्रो द्रोणोऽपि रथिनां वरः। महास्थानतिबलान् वीरान् समरयोधिनः॥
en: Then that foremost of car-warriors namely Drona, received unflinchingly those highly puissant heroic car-warriors, all masters in the art of fighting.

sa: ततः शान्तनवो भीष्मो बीभत्सु नात्यवर्तत॥ भिद्यमानः शितैर्बाणैः सर्वावरणभेदिभिः।
en: Shantanu's son Bhishma assailed not Vibhatsu although he was then being pierced by sharp shafts capable of penetrating through all armours.

sa: युधिष्ठिरं समासाद्य सर्वतः पर्यवारयत्। आपतन्तं गजानीकं दृष्ट्वा वृकोदरः॥
en: Reaching near Yudhishthira, surrounded him on all sides. Then Vrikodara the son of Pritha, beholding the elephant division advance towards himself,

sa: महाभ्रजालमतुलं मातरिश्वेव संततम्। ते वध्यमाना बलिना भीमसेनेन दन्तिनः॥
en: Like the tempest scattering away a mighty network of clouds. The those tuskers, slaughtered by the highly powerful Bhimasena in battle,

sa: एवमुक्तस्ततो द्रोणस्तव पुत्रेण मारिष। अभिनत् पाण्डवानीकं प्रेक्षमाणस्य सात्यकेः॥
en: Thus spoken to on the field by your son, Drona penetrated the Pandava array even before the very eyes of Satyaki.

sa: ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ संन्यषीदं रथोत्तमे। ततो मां कश्मलाविष्टं सूतस्तूर्णमुदावहत्॥
en: Then did I foremost among the Bharatas, faint on that best of cars. My charioteer quickly removed who deprived of consciousness.

sa: ग्लायन्तं भरतश्रेष्ठ रामबाणप्रपीडितम्। ततो मामपयातं वै भृशं विद्धमचेतसम्॥
en: O chief among the Bharatas, seeing me afflicted and struck with the arrows of Rama and removed, being deprived of consciousness,

sa: आरुजन्नपि मे प्राणान् मोहयन्नपि सायकैः॥ प्रहर्षयति मां भूयः सौभद्रः परवीरहा। अति मां नन्दयत्येष सौभद्रो विचरन् रणे॥
en: Indeed this slayer of hostile heroes, this son of Subhadra is affording me great delight, though with his shafts he is afflicting my vital limbs and confounding my senses. This son of Subhadra careering through the field of battle, delights me greatly.

sa: ववुश्च दारुणा वाता रूक्षा घोराभिशंसिनः। सकबन्धस्तथाऽऽदित्ये परिधिः समदृश्यत॥
en: Dry and dreadful winds, portending calamities, began to blow. A headless trunk and a bludgeon became manifest in the solar disc.

sa: ततस्तु द्रौपदीपुत्राः सौभद्रश्च महारथः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥
en: Then the sons of Draupadi, the mighty carwarrior the son of Subhadra, and Nakula, Sahadeva and Dhrishtadyumna the son of Prishata.

sa: न मुञ्चेयमहं बाणमिति कौरवनन्दन। न हन्यामहमेतेन कारणेन शिखण्डिनम्॥
en: I will not let go my weapons, O son of Kuru's race, I will not, for this reason, slay this Shikhandin.

sa: भीष्मस्य समरे राजन् प्रार्थयाना महद् यशः॥ शल्यस्तु नवभिर्बाणैर्भीमसेनमताडयत्।
en: And desirous, o king, of winning great fame in that battle for Bhishma's sake. Then Shalya pierced Bhimasena with nine arrows;

sa: तस्य भार्यासहस्राणां शतमासीन्सहात्मनः। एकैकस्यां च भार्यायां सहस्रं तनयाऽभवन्॥
en: That one of illustrious soul had a hundred thousand wives, and each of these wives was blessed with a thousand sons.

sa: हयारोहवराश्चैव तव पुत्रेण चोदिताः। चतुर्दश सहस्राणि सौबलं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: And supported by fourteen thousand picked cavalry soldiers urged by your son, encompassed on all sides the king of the Subala's.

sa: घटोत्कचस्ततः क्रुद्धो राक्षसं तं महाबलम्। नवत्या सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्दारयामास भारत॥
en: The doer of cruel deeds, Ghototkacha, O descendant of Bharata, wounded that mighty and angry Rakshasa (Alambusha with ninety sharp arrows.

sa: प्रतिसंवार्य चास्त्राणि तेऽन्योन्यस्य विशाम्पते। युयुधुः पाण्डवाश्चैव कौरवाश्च महाबलाः॥
en: In that battle, O lord of men, the Pandavas and the Kauravas, fought with one another hurling weapons at one another.

sa: यथा दुर्योधनस्तात सज्ञातिकुलवान्धवः। तथा त्वमपि सर्वेषां कौरवाणां गतिर्भव॥
en: May you, O son, be the shelter of all the Kauravas, even as Duryodhana is, with his friends, relatives and kinsmen.

sa: तमायान्तं तथा दृष्ट्वा व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्। भीष्मं भीमो महाबाहुः प्रत्युदीयादमर्षितः॥
en: Seeing him make towards himself like the Destroyer with wide upon mouth, the mightyarmed Bhimasena inflamed with rage, rushed towards him.

sa: भूय एव तु संक्रुद्धास्त्वर्जुनं सह केशवम्। आपूरयशरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तडागमिव वृष्टिभिः॥
en: Wrought up with ire, they once again quickly filled Arjuna and Keshava with arrows, like the rains filling up a lake.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजा प्रहस्योलूकमब्रवीत्। धनंजयं पुनर्बुहि वासुदेवस्य शृण्वतः॥
en: Either having defeated us for you rule over this universe or being yourselves defeated by us steep the sleep of heroes.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तथा क्रुद्धः किमकरोद् भगदत्तस्य पाण्डवः। प्राग्ज्योतिषो वा पार्थस्य तन्मे शंस यथातथम्॥
en: Dhritarastra said Wrought up with rage, what did Arjuna the son of Pandu do to Bhagadatta? What did also the ruler of the Pragjyotisas do towards Pritha's son? Tell me all as it happened.

sa: तत्र ब्रह्मा च रुद्रश्च शक्रश्चापि सुरेश्वरः। समेत्य विविधैर्यज्ञैर्यजन्तेऽनेकदक्षिणैः॥
en: There Brahma, Rudra, and Shakra the lord of the celestial, meet together and perform various kinds of sacrifices with large Dakshinas.

sa: शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषं वारणानां च बृहितम्। सिंहनादं च सैन्यानां भीमसेनरवोऽभ्यभूत्॥
en: Bhimasena's roars rose above the sounds of conchs, and drums, the roaring of elephants and the lion-like shouts of the warriors.

sa: दिलीपस्य तु यज्ञेषु कृतः पन्था हिरण्मयः। तं धर्म इव कुर्वाणा: सेन्द्रा देवाः समागमन्॥
en: At all the sacrifices of king Dilipa, the roads used to be constructed of gold. Regarding him equal to Dharma himself, the very Gods and Indra at their head, used to come to him.

sa: संजय उवाच तु दुःसहं दानवैरपि। ततस्तद् बाणवर्षं दधार युधि राजेन्द्रो यथा वर्ष महाद्विपः॥
en: Sanjaya said Then that shower of arrows, which it was difficult even for the Danavas to withstand, was borne by that foremost of kings Duryodhana, like a mighty elephant bearing a shower of rains.

sa: राज्ञो बलं दर्शयन्तस्तव पुत्रस्य भारत॥ शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य त्रातुमैच्छन्महारथाः।
en: And displaying their prowess to your royal son, O descendant of Bharata, desired to rescue Shveta, with Shikhandin at their head.

sa: तेन शब्देन विवस्ता संशप्तकवरूथिनी। विचेष्टाऽवस्थिता संख्ये ह्यश्मसारमयी यथा।॥
en: Terrified at that blare, the car-host of the Samshaptakas stood motionless in the field of battle as if turned into adamant.

sa: विकर्णस्तु महाप्राज्ञो याज्ञसेनि शिखण्डिनम्। पर्यवारयदायान्तं युवानं समरे युवा॥
en: The youthful Vikarna, endued with great intelligence, opposed, in that battle, the youthful Sikhandin, the son of Yajnasena, as he advanced.

sa: अथैनं शरवर्षेण च्छादयामास संयुगे। गिरिं जलागमे यद्वज्जलदा जलवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Also, Bharata, he covered Dhrishtadyumna with showers of arrows, like clouds, swelling with rain, covering a mountain at the rainy season.

sa: न कर्मणामनारम्भान्नैष्कर्म्यं पुरुषोऽस्तुते। न च संन्यसनादेव सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति॥
en: Man does not attain freedom from action by not performing action. By asceticism also, he does not attain to final emancipation.

sa: बृहद्बलश्च कौसल्यो जयत्सेनश्च मागधः। तथा रुक्मरथो राजन् शल्यपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः। बृहत्क्षत्रस्य दायादः सैन्धवश्च जयद्रथः॥
en: Those seven warriors were Brihadbala, the king of the Kosalas, Jayatsena of Magadha, Rukmaratha, the brave son of Shalya, Vinda and Anuvinda of Avanti, Sudakshina the king of the Kambojas, and Jayadratha, the king of the Sindhus and the kinsman of Brihatkshatra.

sa: सम्बभूव महाराज समवाप च यौवनम्। माया हि सहजा तेषां वयो रूपं च कामजम्॥
en: But, O mighty monarch, Alambusha was again born anew, in the fullness of his youth. Illusion is natural with them (the Rakshasas) and their age and appearance are the result of their will. son

sa: विराटद्रुपदौ वीरौ भीष्मं प्रति समुद्यतः॥ तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम वृद्धयोश्चरितं महत्।
en: Still the heroes Virata and Draupada advanced towards Bhishma; we then beheld an admirable feat achieved by those two old warriors,

sa: तलवाभिहताश्चैव ज्याशब्दा भरतर्षभ। पत्तीनां पादशब्दश्च वाजिनां च महास्वनः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, the twang of the bow-strings, the heavy feared of infantry, the furious neighing of horses.

sa: शितैरवाकिरद् बाणैः कलिङ्गानां वरूथिनीम्। कालिङ्गस्तु महेष्वासः पुत्रश्चास्य महारथः॥
en: He covered the Kalingas with showers of sharp arrows. Then that great bowman, the Kalinga king and that car-warriors, his son.

sa: तस्मिन् समुदिते शब्दे तुमुले लोमहर्षणे। बभूव रथनिर्घोषः पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः॥
en: The clatter of the wheels of cars that resembled the roars of clouds, all these mingled together, produced a hair-stirring uproar.

sa: ततः स्वरथमारोप्य लक्ष्मणं गौतमस्तदा। अपोवाह रथेनाजौ सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Thereupon Gautama (Kripa) taking Lakshmana upon his chariot carried him away from the field before the very eyes of the troops.

sa: तमासाद्य महावेगैर्भीष्मो नवभिराशुगैः। विव्याध समरे तूर्णमा नि परवीरहा॥
en: Then that chastiser of foes, Bhishma rushing on him with great impetuosity, soon, wounded the son of Arjuna with nine arrows.

sa: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुलस्तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः। सैनिकानां च सर्वेषां तयोश्च प्रतीतिवर्धनः॥
en: The awful encounter between those two foremost of men enhanced the delight of all the soldiers as also of them both.

sa: दृष्ट्वा चैनं महाराज गदयाभिनिपीडितम्। विचेष्टन्तं यथा नागं मूर्च्छयाभिपरिप्लुतम्॥
en: Seeing Shalya crushed with the stroke of the mace and writhing like a snake and overwhelmed with a swoon, O monarch.

sa: अभिमन्युस्ततः पश्चाद् विराटश्च महारथः। द्रौपदेयाश्च संहृष्टा राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः॥
en: Abhimanyu and the mighty car-warrior Virata, the sons of Draupadi, and the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha were commanded to bring up the rear.

sa: संनिरुद्धाश्च कौरव्यैोणेन च महात्मना। एतेऽन्ये मण्डलीभूताः पावकेनेव कुञ्जराः॥
en: Impeded by the Kauravas and by the highsoulcd Drona, they are huddling together, like a herd of elephants encompassed in conflagration.

sa: तत्प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणेनामिततेजसा। नाशक्नुवन् वारयितुं समस्तास्ते महारथाः॥
en: Beholding their array thus shattered by Drona of immeasurable prowess, all those mighty car-warrior were not able to check the former.

sa: प्राग्ज्योतिषादनु नृपः कौसल्योऽथ बृहद्बलः। मेकलैः कुरुविन्दैश्च त्रैपुरैश्च समन्वितः॥
en: After king of Pragjyotishapur, came Brihadbala the ruler of the Kosalas, being supported by the Mekalas, the Tripuras and the Chichitas.

sa: शबलास्तु बृहन्तोऽश्वादान्ता जाम्बूनदस्रजः। युद्धे सत्यधृति क्षेमिमवहन् प्रांशवः शुभाः॥
en: Excellent and tall steeds, of huge bodies, variegated hue, excecdingly docile and caparisoned with golden chains, bore Satyadhriti accomplished in battle.

sa: येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विता। तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम्॥
en: Even those, O son of Kunti, who endued with faith, worship other gods, worship Me thought not in the regular way.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच स्थितप्रज्ञस्य का भाषा समाधिस्थस्य केशव। स्थितधीः किं प्रभाषेत किमासीत व्रजेत किम्॥
en: Arjuna said "What are the characteristics, O Keshava, of one whose mind is steady, and whose understanding is devotional? How does the man of steady-mind speak, how does he sit, how does he move?"

sa: प्रत्यदृश्यत देवर्षि रदस्तस्य संनिधौ। उवाच चैनं दुःखार्ते विलपन्तमचेतसम्॥
en: The celestial Rishi Narada revealed himself before the king. And he spoke these words to the bewailing and woc-stricken and senseless.

sa: ते नैव शख्याः सहसा विजेतुं वीर्योद्धताः कृतवैरास्त्वया च। अहं सेनां प्रतियोत्स्यामि राजन् सर्वात्मना जीवितं त्यज्य वीर।।१०
en: These heroes are not to be so easily vanquished; they entertain feelings of the bitterest hostility for you, and are more ever swelling with their powers. Yet O monarch, I will, with all my soul fight these heroes to the bitter end.

sa: तस्य शोकं विदित्वा तु पुत्रव्यसनसम्भवम्। आजगामाथ देवर्षिर्नारदोऽस्य समीपतः॥
en: Then cognisant of his grief caused by the death of his son, there came near him the celestial sage Narada himself.

sa: अथैत्य राजा युधि सत्यसंधो जयद्रथोऽत्युग्रबलो मनस्वी। चिच्छेद चापानि महारथानां प्रसह्य तेषां धनुषा वरेण॥
en: Then king Jayadratha, highly intelligent and endued with great strength, and never failing in his aims in battle, advancing upon those mighty car-warriors forcibly served their bows by means of his own excellent bow.

sa: तथा प्रतिभये तस्मिन् देवदानवसंकुले। खाण्डवे युध्यमानस्य कः सहायस्तदाऽवत्॥
en: Then again in that terrific battle between the gods and the Danavas fighting together at Khandava who was then my friend?

sa: जातरूपसमाभासा: सर्वे लोहितकध्वजाः। ते हेममालिनः शूराः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः॥
en: All these heroes accomplished in battle, having complexions effulgent like god, owning standards of red huc and be-decked with golden chains.

sa: विविंशतिस्तु सहसा व्यश्वकेतुशरासनम्। भीमं चक्रे महाराज ततः सैनयान्यपूजयन्॥
en: But O mighty sovereign, Vivinsati suddenly deprived Bhimasena of his horses, standard and bow; and then the troops highly applauded him.

sa: अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि आख्यानमिदमुत्तमम्। कथितं नारदेनेह पितुर्मम नराधिप॥
en: I shall now tell you in this connection an excellent story repeated to my father by Narada, O ruler of men.

sa: स तु तेनैव कोपेन राजन् गाङ्गेयमुक्तवान्। त्वयि जीवति कौरव्य नाहं योत्स्ये कदाचन॥ त्वया तु पाण्डवेयेषु निहतेषु महामृधे। दुर्योधनमनुज्ञाप्य वनं यास्यामि कौरव॥
en: Out of wrath (excited by this classification of himself, he had thus addressed, O king, the son of Ganga-'O Kaurava, I will not fight so long as you live; if you shall slay in battle the Sons of Pandu, O you of Kuru'a race, I will retire into the woods with the permission of Duryodhana.

sa: तं तु नानाप्रहरणैर्नानायुद्धविशेषणैः। राक्षसं राक्षसः क्रुद्धः समाजघ्ने ह्यलम्बुषः॥
en: Excited with wrath, Rakshasa Alambusha began to strike that Rakshasa (Ghatotkacha) with various kinds of weapons and various implements of war.

sa: स कृत्वा पितृकर्म त्वं पुत्रं संस्थाप्य सत्पथे। वर्तेथा यदि धर्मेण न त्वां व्यसनमाव्रजेत्॥
en: If, again, doing the duty of a father, you had (by directing Duryodhana on the path of virtue) compelled him to follow in the same path, then this calamity would never have befallen you.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु संक्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नं महारणे। विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैश्चतुर्भिः समरे द्रुतम्॥
en: Inflamed with wrath, Duryodhana in that fierce battle pierced Dhrishtadyumna with four whetted arrows; and in battle, the feat was wonderful.

sa: एवमुक्तास्तत: सर्वे धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैनिकाः। अभ्यद्रवन्त संक्रुद्धा भीमसेन महाबलम्॥
en: Thus spoken to, all the warriors belonging to the army of Dhritarashtra's son, furious in at Bhimasena endued with superhuman strength.

sa: स युद्धकुशलः पार्थो बाहुवीर्येण चान्वितः। अभिनत् कुञ्जरानीकमचिरेणैव मारिष॥
en: And, O sire, that of Pritha, accomplished in battle and endued with strength of arms, soon shattered that host of elephants.

sa: स द्रोणमभिवाद्याथ कृत्वा चाभिप्रदक्षिणम्। उवाच राजा दुर्धर्षमात्मनिःश्रेयसं वचः॥
en: Then bowing down to Drona and walking round him, he spoke these words to that invincible hero, words beneficial to him.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा कलिङ्गैर्बहुभिर्वृतः। पुरस्कृत्य रणे भीष्मं पाण्डवानभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana surrounded by a large number of the Kalingas and placing Bhishma at the head, charged the Pandava host.

sa: अनन्तरं च काम्बोजो जलसंधश्च मारिष। दुर्योधनश्च कर्णश्च तदनन्तरमेव॥
en: After him were stationed the Kamboja Princes and also Jalasandha, O sire, Behind them stood Duryodhana and Karna, in the Sakata.

sa: ततः शरसहस्राणि बहूनि भरतर्षभ। प्रेषयामास समरे द्रौणिः परमकोपनः॥
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, Drona's son inflamed with rage, sped, in that battle many thousands of shafts (against Shikhandin).

sa: गृहीतं पाणिना पाणि भीमसेनस्य रक्षसा। नामृष्यत महाबाहुस्तत्राक्रुध्यद् वृकोदरः॥
en: His hand having been seized by the Rakshasas, the mighty-armed Vrikodara (Bhima), without being able to brook it, flew into rage.

sa: मयि क्रुद्धे जगन्न स्यान्मयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। देवदानवगन्धर्वाः किन्नरोरगराक्षसाः॥ न मे क्रुद्धस्य पर्याप्ताः सर्वे लोकाः शुचिस्मिते। चक्षुषा यं प्रपश्यामि तस्य तेजो हराम्यहम्॥
en: At my being angry the world will be annihilated; everything depends on me. The gods, the Danavas and the Gandharvas, the Kinnaras, the serpents and the Rakashasas, not all of these, not all the world even can stand against me when I am angry. Whoever I see by my eyes, his strength do I absorb.

sa: ततो राज्ञाभ्यनुज्ञाताः पाण्डवानां महारथः॥ भीमसेनमुखाः सर्वे पुत्रास्ते प्रत्युपाद्रवन्।
en: Thereupon obtaining the command of the king all the mighty car-warriors of the Pandavas headed by Bhimasena rushed upon your sons.

sa: भारं हि मयि संन्यस्य यातो मधुनिहा हरिः। यज्ञं भारतसिंहस्य न हि शक्योऽद्य मर्षितुम्॥
en: Giving charge (of the city) to me, the slayer of Madhu, Hari (Krishna), has gone to the sacrifice of the foremost of the Bharata race (Yudhishthira). Therefore I cannot bear to be quiet now.

sa: भो भो माया यदृच्छा वा न विद्यः किमिदं भवेत्। असं त्विदं कथं मिथ्या मम कश्च व्यतिक्रमः॥
en: O sire, O sire, is this an illusion or a caprice (on the part of the weapon)? I do not know what this may be? Why has this weapon been repulsed? What has been my fault in the method of its invocation?

sa: पृथिवी भूयसी तात मम पार्थस्य नो तथा। इति मामब्रवीत् सूत मन्दो दुर्योधनः पुरा॥
en: All this extensive earth has taken my side, O sire and not that of the sons of Pritha.' 0 Suta, these were the words that were spoken to ine by the wicked Duryodhana before.

sa: यत्रार्या रुदती भीता पाण्डवानिदमब्रवीत्। महद् व्यसनमापन्ना शिखिना परिवारिता॥
en: It was then the revered madam (Kunti), overtaken by this calamity and surrounded by the flames, began to cry in terrors.

sa: तेऽभिजग्मुर्जितक्रोधा जितात्मानो जितेन्द्रियाः। पितामहस्य भवनं जगतः कृपया तदा॥
en: Being moved by compassion, they with their passions, senses and souls under complete control, went to the abode of the Grandsire.

sa: शैलास्तस्यास्थिसंज्ञास्तु मेदो मांसं च मेदिनी। समुद्रास्तस्य रुधिरमाकाशमुदरं तथा॥
en: The Mountains from his bones. the Earth forins his fat and flesh. the Oceans constitute his blood. space is his stomach.

sa: आवृतानि वरस्त्रीभिर्गृहाणि सुमहान्त्यपि। प्रचलन्तीव भारेण दृश्यन्ते स्म महीतले॥
en: The spacious mansions, filled with the ladies of rank, seemed to tremble under their weight to fall over upon the ground.

sa: एवमुक्तस्ततो हंसमुत्ससर्ज महीपतिः। ते तु हंसाः समुत्पत्य विदर्भानगमंस्ततः॥
en: Thus spoken, the king liberated the swan. Thereafter the swans, spreading their wings, betook themselves to the country of the Vidharbhas.

sa: दर्पान्मानः समभवन्मानात् क्रोधो व्यजायत। क्रोधादह्रीस्ततोऽलज्जा वृत्तं तेषां ततोऽनशत्॥
en: Pride begot vanity and vanity begot wealth. From wealth arose every king of evil propensity and from evil propensities arose shamelessness.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा भरतश्रेष्ठो गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान्। उदतिष्ठत युद्धाय शक्रो वृत्रमिवाह्वयन्॥
en: Having said these words, that energetic prince, of Bharata's race, stood up for battle, like Shakra summoning Vritra to an encounter.

sa: किञ्चित्प्राणैश्च पुरुषैर्हतैश्चान्यैः सहस्रशः॥ बहुना च गजाश्वेन भूरभूद् भीमदर्शना।
en: The Earth became terrible to look at, covered with thousands of human beings, dead and dying, and numberless horses and elephants.

sa: त्वन्नियोगकरावेताविति मे नारदोऽब्रवीत्। तथा नारायण पुरा क्रतुभिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः॥ इष्टवांस्त्वं महासत्रं कृष्ण चैत्ररथे वने। नैवं परे नापरे वा करिष्यन्ति कृतानि वा॥ कृतवान् पुण्डरीकाक्ष बलदेवसहायवान्। कैलासभवने चापि ब्राह्मणैर्व्यवस: सह॥
en: It was Narada who has told me (all) this. O Narayana, you performed in the forest of Chaitraratha a grand sacrifice with multitudes of rites and plentiful of gifts. O lotus-eyed deity the feats you accomplished with your prowess aided by Baladeva have never before been done by others. They are not capable of being done by others in future. You dwelt even in Kailasa accompanied by Brahmanas.

sa: वैयाघ्रकोशः सुमहान् भीमसेनस्य सायकः। गुरुभारसहो दिव्यः शात्रवाणां भयंकरः॥
en: This celestials huge sword, cased in tiger skin, capable of bearing heavy weight and dreadful to the enemies, belongs to Bhimasena.

sa: तथा विमुक्तो बलिनार्कतेजाः प्रज्वालयामास दिशो नभश्च। ततोऽर्जुनस्तस्य शिरो जहार वृत्रस्य वज्रेण यथा महेन्द्रः॥
en: Discharged by that mighty heroic that arrow, effulgent like the sun, emblazoned all the quarters. With that arrow Arjuna struck off his enemy's head like Indra striking the head of Vritra with his thunder.

sa: तत्त्वानि यो वेदयते यथातथं गुणांश्च सर्वानखिलांश्च देवताः। विधूतपाप्मा प्रतिमुच्य बन्धनं स सर्वलोकानमलान् समश्नुते॥
en: Hc who understands the elements accurately, all the qualities, all the celestials, succeeds in purifying himself of all sin. Freed from all fetters, such a man succeeds in enjoying all regions of spotless purity.

sa: क्रोधात् प्रस्फुरमाणैष्टो धनुरुद्यम्य भारत। योधयामास वै पार्थ महावेगपराक्रमः॥
en: With lips trembling in anger, he, of great energy and prowess, took up his bow and began to fight with Arjuna.

sa: भगवान् वा हृषीकेशस्त्रैलोक्यस्य परो गुरुः। ऋषे यदकरोद्वीरस्तच्च व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: You should tell me also, O Rishi, what the heroic Hrishikesha, the supreme lord of the three worlds, did after this.

sa: तपनीयनिभौ चित्रौ कल्पवृक्षाविव दुमौ। किंशुकाविव चोत्फुल्ली प्रकाशेते रणाजिरे॥
en: A fair of beautiful Kalpa trees or a couple of handsome Kinsuka trees laden with flowers, on the field of battle.

sa: कच्चिद् धर्मसुतो राजा त्वया प्रत्यभिनन्दितः। भीमार्जुनयमाश्चैव कच्चिदेतेऽपि सान्त्विताः॥
en: Have the high-minded and great king Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma, and Bhima and Arjuna, and the twins, been sufficiently comforted?

sa: किमत्र तथ्यं सुश्रोणि मिथ्या किं ब्रूहि शोभने। श्रुत्वा त्वत्तः शुभं वाक्यं संविधास्याम्यहं तथा॥
en: ( you of beautiful hips, tell me what is truth is (this case) and O beautiful lady, what is false. O auspicious one, having heard from you, I will make arrangements (how to act).

sa: यन्मन्येत ममाभावादस्याभावो भवेदिति। तस्मिन् कुर्वीत विश्वासं यथा पितरि वै तथा॥ तं शक्त्या वर्धमानश्च सर्वतः परिबृंहयेत्। नित्यं क्षताद् वारयति यो धर्मेष्वपि कर्मसु॥ क्षताद् भीतं विजानीयादुत्तमं मित्रलक्षणम्। ये तस्य क्षतमिच्छन्ति ते तस्य रिपवः स्मृताः॥
en: He who would meet with ruin by your fall, should be trusted by you completely even as you should trust your father. You should, to the best of your power, advance him as you secure advancement for yourself. One who, in even your religious rites, tries to save you from harm, would try to save you from harm in every other transaction. Such a one should be known as your best friend. They, on the other hand, who wish one harm are one's enemies.

sa: तेन शब्देन वीराणां पातपित्वा मनांस्युत। दर्शयन् घोरमात्मानममित्रान् सहसाभ्ययात्॥
en: With that sound, causing the hearts of his enemies to be depressed, he rushed upon the foe, assuming a dreadful aspect.

sa: भारद्वाजं शरौघाभ्यां महद्भ्यामभ्यवर्षताम्। तौ तथा संजयाश्चैव पञ्चालाश्च महौजसः॥
en: They rained upon the son of Bharadvaja two mighty downpours of arrows. Then the Srinjayas and those great car-warriors, the Panchalas.

sa: अपराण्यपि चत्वारि शतानि द्विजसत्तम। नीयमानानि संतारे हृतान्यासन् वितस्तया॥
en: The other four hundred, O best among the twice-born while being led across (the Vitasta river) were robbed by the river.

sa: पाण्डवा धृतराष्ट्रेण प्रेषिता वारणावतम्। उत्सवे विहरिष्यन्ति धृतराष्ट्रस्य शासनात्॥
en: The Pandavas have been sent by Dhritarashtra to Varanavata. They will sport there in the festival at the command of Dhritarashtra.

sa: शल्य उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु तां देवीं विसृज्य च वराननाम्। विमाने योजयित्वा च ऋषीन् नियममास्थितान्॥ अब्रह्मण्यो बलोपेतो मत्तो मदबलेन च। कामवृत्तः स दुष्टात्मा वाहयामास तानृषीन्॥
en: Shalya said O king! O you of bright complexion and having dismissed that lovely face one, he yoked, to car, Rishis who used to observe the rules of their class. The habits of his life being unworthy of a Brahmana, having come to the possession of power, vain of his strength, willful and of a vicious nature, he made the Rishis carry him.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ममापि परमा भक्तिर्ब्राह्मणेषु सदा द्विजाः। सहायविपरिभ्रंशस्त्वयं सादयतीव माम्॥ आहरेयुरिमे येऽपि फलमूलमधूनि च। त इमे शोकजैर्दुःखैर्धातरो मे विमोहिताः॥ द्रौपद्या विप्रकर्षण राज्यापहरणेन च। दुःखार्दितानिमान् क्लेशैर्नाहं योक्तुमिहोत्सहे॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O Brahmanas, I have always great devotion towards the Brahmanas. But this destitution has overwhelmed me. My these brothers who are to procure fruits and roots and the deer are stupified with grief for the afflictions that have overtaken them and for the distress of Draupadi and for the loss of our kingdom. Alas, as they are distressed, I cannot employ them in painful tasks!

sa: मत्तवारणयूथानि पङ्कक्लिन्नानि भारत। वर्षतामिव मेघानां वृन्दानि ददृशे तदा॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, he saw herds of mad elephants besmeared with mud. They looked like masses of clouds pouring rains.

sa: त्रैलोक्ये क्षत्रधर्मो हि श्रेयान् वै साधुचारिणाम्। नान्यं धर्मं प्रशंसन्ति ये च धर्मविदो जनाः॥
en: For honest men the practices of the Kshatriyas are the best in the three worlds. The men that are learned in the precepts of virtue praise nothing else (then the practices of the Kshatriyas).

sa: ततोऽहं जामदग्न्याय भृशं क्रोधसमन्वितः। चिक्षेप मृत्युसंकाशं बाणं सर्पविषोपमम्॥
en: Greatly incensed , I darted, at the son of Jamadagni, a deadly shaft, comparable to the poison of a serpent only.

sa: स एवमुक्तो दुःखार्तः सत्यवागृषिसत्तमः। सर्वलोकविनाशाय मतिं चक्रे महामनाः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, that truthful and excellent Rishi became grieved and that high-souled man resolved to destroy the whole creation.

sa: प्रीतश्चास्मि महाबाहो शासनस्य प्रतिग्रहात्। त्वां चाहमभिषेक्ष्यामि प्रीतियुक्तो नराधिपम्॥
en: I have been greatly pleased that you have satisfied my behests. I shall, now pleased, install you on the royal throne.

sa: महर्षीस्तु पुरत्कृत्य प्रयान्तु तव सैनिकाः। यथा ग्रीष्मवशेषेण तरेयुर्जाह्नवीजलम्॥ तत्र स्थाप्य बलं सर्वं नदीतीरे समाहितः। अग्रतो धनुषा सार्धं गच्छ त्वं लघुविक्रम ॥
en: Let the soldiers only now proceed with ascetics before them; the summer has not as yet fully expired and this is the time, when they shall, without any trouble, be able to cross the Gangā. Afterwards having encamped your army on the other side of the Gangā you should alone proceed speedily with your bow.

sa: भाषतस्तस्य शूद्रस्य खङ्गं सुरुचिरप्रभम्। निष्कृष्य कोशाद्विमलं शिरश्चिच्छेद राघवः॥
en: The Sūdra ascetic having said this, Rama took out of scabbard a beautiful sharp sword and chopped off his head therewith.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणेनोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः। प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः प्रहसनराघवो वचः॥
en: Hearing the words of Laksmana and smiling, the highly effulgent descendant of Raghu, Rāma, skilled in the are of speech, replied.

sa: अस्माकमेषा सुश्रोणी प्रभुत्वे वर्तते सदा। अपतिः काननान्तेषु सहास्माभिश्चरत्यसौ॥
en: This fair damsel is our supreme lady. She has no husband. Journeying she has come here in the forest with us.

sa: बुधस्तु पुरुषीभूतं स वै संवत्सरान्तरम्। कथाभी रमयामास धर्मयुक्ताभिरात्मवान्॥
en: There upon after a year Ilā having regained the male form, Budha by means of various words afforded delight to him.

sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्य महात्मनः। सर्वेषामृषिमुख्यानां साधुवादो महानभूत्॥
en: Hearing the words of the high-souled Rāma, all the high-souled Rșis began to speak of him in high terms and said.

sa: ततो रामः शुभां वाणी देवदेवस्य भाषिताम्॥ श्रुत्वा परमतेजस्वी वाल्मीकिमिदमब्रवीत्। भगवश्रोतुमनस ऋषयो ब्राह्मलौकिकाः॥ भविष्यदुत्तरं यन्मे श्वोभूते संप्रवर्तताम्।
en: Hearing the words of the great Patriarch instinct with well-being, the highly effulgent Rāma said to Vālmīki. O illustrious sir, the Rşis living in Brahmă's region have grown desirous of hearing my future history. So let it be taken up next morning.

sa: वेदा ब्राह्मणरूपेण गायत्री सर्वरक्षिणी। ओङ्कारोऽथ वषट्कारः सर्वे राममनुव्रताः॥
en: And also went with him the four Vedas in the shape of the Brāhmaṇas, the all protecting Gayatri, Omkara and Vasatkāra.

sa: तस्मिन्येऽपि समापन्ना ऋक्षवानरराक्षसाः। तेऽपि स्वर्ग प्रविविशुदेहानिक्षिप्य चाम्भसि ।।२७
en: Having renounced their bodies in the water there of all the bears, monkeys and Raksasas attained to the land of deities.

sa: इदं द्वैपायनः पूर्वं पुत्रमध्यापयच्छुकम्॥ ततोऽन्येभ्योऽनुरूपेभ्यः शिष्येभ्यः प्रददौ विभुः।
en: He first taught this epitome to his son Shuka and then to others of his disciples who had the same qualifications.

sa: वनवासोऽर्जुनस्यापि सुभद्राहरणं ततः। हरणाहरणं चैव दहनं खाण्डवस्य च॥
en: Arjuna's exile into jungle, the stealing of Subhadra, the gift and receipt of the inarriage dower, the burning of Khandava forest,

sa: वारणावतयात्रायां मन्त्रो दुर्योधनस्य च। कूटस्य धार्तराष्ट्रेण प्रेषणं पाण्डवान्प्रति॥
en: The conspiracy of Duryodhana to send the Pandavas to Varanavata and other plotting of the sons of Dhritarashtra against the Pandavas;

sa: संदेशादर्जुनस्यात्र तीर्थाभिगमनक्रिया। तीर्थानां च फलप्राप्तिः पुण्यत्वं चापि कीर्तितम्॥
en: The pilgrimages of the Pandavas to various holy places as asked by Arjuna; their attainment of merit and virtue in consequence;

sa: अनाश्रित्यैतदाख्यानं कथा भुवि न विद्यते। आहारमनपाश्रित्य शरीरस्येव धारणम्॥
en: As the body depends on the food is takes, so all the stories current in the world depend on this work.

sa: यथावीर्यस्त्वया सर्पः कृतोऽयं मद्विभीषया। तथावीर्यो भुजंगस्त्वं मम शापाद्भविष्यसि॥
en: "As you made a powerful mock snake to frighten me, you will yourself turn into a venomless serpent by my curse."

sa: स जातमात्रो विनतां परित्यज्य खमाविशत्। आदास्यन्नात्मनो भोज्यमन्नं विहितमस्य यत्। विधात्रा भृगुशार्दूल क्षुधितः पतगेश्वरः॥
en: As soon as he was born, he left his mother and the king of the birds, being hungry, mounted on his wings to seek for the food assigned to him by the great Ordainer.

sa: त्रैलोक्यं मोहितं यस्य गन्धमाघ्राय तद्विषम्। प्राग्रसल्लोकरक्षार्थं ब्रह्मणो वचनाच्छिवः॥
en: The three worlds were stupified by its terrible smell; and then Shiva, asked by Brahma, swallowed it to save the creation.

sa: तस्य कण्ठमनुप्राप्ते दानवस्यामृते तदा। आख्यातं चन्द्रसूर्याभ्यां सुराणां हितकाम्यया॥
en: When the Ambrosia has only reached his throat, Chandra and Surya (recognised him and) informed the celestials of what had happened.

sa: ततो देवाः सर्षिगणा उपगम्य पितामहम्॥ अब्रुवन्किमिवेहाद्य महद्दाहकृतं भयम्।
en: Then the celestials with the Rishis went to the Grandsire (Brahma) and said, "What is this great and fearful heat today?"

sa: न ह्येवमग्निर्नादित्यो भस्म कुर्यात्तथाऽनघ॥ यथा कुर्यादभिक्रुद्धो ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः।
en: O sinless one, neither fire nor the sun does consume so much as does a Brahman of rigid austerity when angry.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच शेषोऽसि नागोत्तम धर्मदेवो महीमिमां धारयसे यदेकः। अनन्तभोगैः परिगृह्य सर्वां यथाऽहमेवं बलभिद्यथा वा॥
en: Brahma said: O Shesha, O best of snakes, you are the Dharma, because you hold the earth alone with your infinite hoods, with every thing on her, what I myself and Indra can do.

sa: काश्यप उवाच नृपं कुरुकुलोत्पन्न परिक्षितमरिन्दमम्। तक्षकः पन्नगश्रेष्ठस्तेजसाऽद्य प्रधक्ष्यति॥
en: Kashyapa said: The best of snakes, Takshaka, will to-day burn the chastiser of his enemies, king Parikshit of the Kuru race;

sa: चरन्दीक्षां महातेज दुश्चरामकृतात्मभिः। तीर्थेष्वाप्लवनं कृत्वा पुण्येषु विचचार ह॥
en: The greatly powerful Rishi roamed about, bathing in various sacred waters and practising various vows, difficult to be practised by others.

sa: दृष्टिर्भ्राम्यति मेतीव हृदयं दीर्यतीव च। पतिष्याम्यवशोऽद्याहं तस्मिन्दीप्ते विभावसौ॥
en: My sight is falling, my heart is trembling. Being be-numbed, I may fall into the blazing fire (of the sacrifice) today.

sa: इमे च ते सूर्यसमानवर्चसः समासते वृत्रहणः क्रतुं यथा। नैषां ज्ञातं विद्यते ज्ञानमद्य दत्तं येभ्यो न प्रणश्येत्कदाचित्॥
en: These (learned men), that are sitting here, are as effulgent as the sun and they make your this sacrifice like the sacrifice of the slayer of Vitra (Indra). There is nothing for them to know and gifts made to them become inexhaustible.

sa: गुरोर्वचनमाज्ञाय स तु विप्रर्षभस्तदा। आचचक्षे ततः सर्वमितिहासं पुरातनम्॥
en: Sauti said: That best of Brahmanas, (Vaishampayana), having been thus commanded by his preceptor, recited the whole of that old history,

sa: न च पित्रा विभज्यन्ते पुत्रा गुरुहिते रताः। युञ्जते धुरि नो गाश्च कृशान्संधुक्षयन्ति च॥
en: The sons never divide their wealth here with their fathers. They are always mindful of their parent's welfare. Lean kine are never yoked to the plough or to the cart engaged in carrying merchandise.

sa: तदा निःक्षत्रिये लोके भार्गवेण कृते सति। ब्राह्मणाक्षत्रिया राजन्सुतार्थिन्योऽभिचक्रमुः॥
en: O king, when the earth was thus bereft of Kshatriyas, the Kshatriya women used to come to the Brahmanas for offspring.

sa: तस्मादवरजो यस्तु राजन्नश्वपतिः स्मृतः। दैतेयः सोऽभवद्राजा हार्दिक्यो मनुजर्षभः॥
en: O king, that son of Diti, the younger brother of Ashva, who was known as Ashvapati, became the mighty king Hardikya.

sa: यस्त्वासीद्देवको नाम देवराजसमद्युतिः। स गन्धर्वपतिर्मुख्यः क्षितौ जज्ञे नराधिपः॥
en: The best of the kings of the Gandharvas was born on earth as Devaka who was as effulgent as Indra himself.

sa: तानि षोडश देवीनां सहस्राणि नराधिप। बभूवुर्मानुषे लोके वासुदेवपरिग्रहः॥ श्रियस्तु भाग: संजज्ञे रत्यर्थं पृथिवीतले।
en: O king, sixteen thousand portions of these celestial ladies, became in the world of men the wives of Vasudeva. A portion of Sree (Lakshmi), herself became incarnate on earth out of love (for Narayana).

sa: सिद्धिधृतिश्च ये देव्यौ पञ्चानां मातरौ तु ते। कुन्ती माद्री च जज्ञाते मतिस्तु सुबलात्मजा॥
en: The goddesses Siddhi and Dhriti became the mothers of the five (Pandavas). They were named Kunti and Madri. And the goddess, who was Mati, became the daughter of Subala (Gandhari, the wife of Dhritarashtra).

sa: एवमुक्तः स राजर्षिस्तपोवीर्यसमाश्रयात्। संचारयामास जरां तदा पुत्रे महात्मनि॥
en: Thus being addressed, the royal sage (Yayati) transferred his old age on his highsouled son (Puru) with his power of asceticism.

sa: देवयान्युवाच केनास्यर्थेन नृपते इमं देशमुपागतः। जिघृक्षुर्वारिज किंचिदथवा मृगलिप्सया॥
en: Devayani said : O king, why have you come here? Is it to gather lotuses, or to angle, or to hunt.

sa: ययातिरुवाच न मिथ्याहं विक्रयं वै स्मरामि वृथा गृहीतं शिशुकाच्छङ्कमानः। विधिसमानः किमु तत्र साधु॥
en: Yayati said : I do not remember to have ever bought or sold any thing in an unfair way. This has also never been done by other kings. How shall I do it then?

sa: विचित्रवीर्यश्चित्राङ्गदश्च। तयोरप्राप्तयौवन एव चित्राङ्गदो गन्धर्वेण हतः; विचित्रवीर्यस्तु राजाऽऽसीत्॥
en: Namely Vichitravirya and Chitrangada. But before they attained to their youth, Chitrangada was killed by the Gandharvas. Therefore, Vichitravirya became king.

sa: महाभाग्यं च नृपते रतस्य महात्मनः। यस्येतिहासो द्युतिमान् महाभारतमुच्यते॥
en: And the great fortune of the illustrious king of the Bharata race, the history of whom is called this effulgent Mahabharata.

sa: देवर्षिपितृयज्ञार्थमारभ्यन्त तदा क्रियाः। न चाधर्मेण केषांचित् प्राणिनामभवद् वधः॥
en: The sacrifices in honour of the celestials, Rishis and Pitris were performed but no creature was sinfully deprived of its life.

sa: अथ पारशवीं कन्यां देवकस्य महीपतेः। रूपयौवनसम्पन्नां स शुश्रावायगासुतः॥
en: The son of the river (Bhishma) heard that king Devaka had a daughter, young and beautiful, born in a Shudra wife.

sa: अस्माकमपि ते जन्म विदितं कमलेक्षण॥ कृष्णद्वैपायनाद्भीरु कुरूणां वंशवृद्धये।
en: O louts-eyed one, O timid girl, you know our birth, begotten by Krishna Dvaipayana, in order to expand the Kuru race.

sa: सा त्वं माद्री प्लवेनैव तारयैनामनिन्दिते। अपत्यसंविभागेन परां कीर्तिमवाप्नुहि॥
en: O blameless one, rescue Madri with a raft of offspring; and achieve imperishable fame by making her a mother of children.”

sa: कुरूंश्च विप्रमुख्यांश्च भोजयित्वा सहस्रशः। रत्नौघान् विप्रमुख्येभ्यो दत्त्वा ग्रामवरांस्तथा॥
en: They feasted the Kurus and also many thousands of Brahmanas, whom they gave many gems and much wealth with many villages.

sa: ततस्तु शयने दिव्ये नागदत्ते महाभुजः। अशेत भीमसेनस्तु यथासुखमरिंदमः॥
en: Thereupon, that chastiser of foes, that mighty armed Bhimasena lay down in happiness on a celestial bed given by the Nagas.

sa: पश्यैनं तं दुमाग्रस्थं भासं नरवरात्मजा श्यामीत्येवमाचार्यं प्रत्युवाच युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: “O prince, behold that bird on the top of the tree.” Yudhisthira replied to the preceptor, "O Sir, I see it."

sa: पञ्चभिर्धातृभिः पार्थैर्द्राणः परिवृतो बभौ। पञ्चतारेण संयुक्तः सावित्रेणेव चन्द्रमाः॥
en: Drona was surrounded by the five brothers, the sons of Pritha and looked like the moon surrounded by the five constellations.

sa: ततः किीटी सहसा पाञ्चालान् समरेऽद्रवत्। छादयन्निषुजालेन महता मोहयन्निव॥
en: Kirti (Arjuna) immediately assailed the Panchalas in the battle and covering them with a shower of arrows, he greatly confused them.

sa: सत्कृताश्चैव पौरैस्ते पौरान् सत्कृत्य चानघ। अलंकृतं जनाकीर्णं विविशुर्वारणावतम्॥
en: Being welcomed by the citizens and welcoming them in return, those sinless ones (the Pandavas) entered the populous and ornamented Varanavata.

sa: सहैवैतैर्गमिष्यामि बान्धवैरद्य राक्षसम्। ततो नः सहितान् क्षुद्रः सर्वानेवोपभोक्ष्यति॥
en: I shall today with all my family, go to that Rakshasas so that, that wretch may devour us all at once.

sa: अथ धर्मार्थवद् वाक्यमुक्त्वा स भगवानृषिः। विचित्राश्च कथास्तास्ताः पुनरेवेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : That illustrious Rishi thus spoke many worlds of virtuous import. Speaking on various subjects, he again spoke thus-

sa: कामः कमलपत्राक्षि प्रतिविध्यति मामयम्। तस्मात् कुरु विशालाक्षि मय्यनुक्रोशमङ्गने॥
en: O lotus eyed lady, O lady of large eyes, the god of love is incessantly piercing me, be merciful towards me.

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् गिरिवरे शुचिर्भूत्वा कृताञ्जलिः। आरिराधयिषुः सूर्यं तस्थावर्ध्वमु तौ॥
en: Then the king becoming pure and folding his hands, worshipped Surya with his face turned upwards on that best of mountains.

sa: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञामभिवाद्य कृताञ्जलिः। उवाच नृपतिः काले वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम्॥
en: Regaining his consciousness, the king saluted the Rishi with joined hands and he thus spoke to that best of Rishis Vasishtha.

sa: आगर्भादवकृन्तन्तश्चेरुः सर्वां वसुन्धराम्। तत उच्छिद्यमानेषु भृगुष्वेवं भयात् तदा॥
en: When they were thus killed, many Bhrigu Women fled in fear and took shelter in the inaccessible mountains of the Himalayas.

sa: गत्वैका कथयामास क्षत्रियाणामुपहरे। ततस्ते क्षत्रिया जग्मुस्तं गर्भं हन्तुमुद्यता:॥
en: Thereupon the Kshatriyas went with the intention of destroying that embryo and saw the Brahmana lady blazing in her own splendour.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ते समेत्य ततः सर्वे कथयन्ति स्म भारत। अथ द्वैपायनो राजन्नभ्यागच्छद् यदृच्छया।॥
en: Vaishampayana said : o descendant of Bharata, o king, thereupon those three (Kunti, Yudhishthira and Dhrishtaduymna) discoursed on this matter; and at that very time Dvaipayana came there (wandering over the world) at pleasure.

sa: रूपयौवनदाक्षिण्यैरुपेताश्च स्वलंकृताः। प्रेष्याः सम्प्रददौ कृष्णो नाना देश्याः स्वलंकृताः।।१६।
en: Krishna gave them thousands of maidservants, all young, beautiful and accomplished and adorned with all ornaments and brought from various countries.

sa: तमिमं समुपातिष्ठ धर्मं कुरुकुलोचितम्। अनुरूपं महाबाहो पूर्वेषामात्मनः कुरु॥
en: Therefore, follow the practice that is worthy of the Kuru race. O mighty-armed hero, act as your forefathers did before you.

sa: कथयामास कृष्णायै भगवन्तमुपस्थितम्। श्रुत्वैतद् द्रौपदी चापि शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहिता॥
en: He sent words to Krishna informing her of the arrival of the high-souled (Rishi). Hearing it, Draupadi, after properly purifying herself.

sa: स्त्रीभिर्माल्यैश्च गन्धैश्च भक्ष्यभोज्यैः सुपुष्कलैः। पानैश्च विविधैर्हद्यैः परां प्रीतिमवापतुः॥
en: They derived great pleasure in women, in garlands, in perfumes, in viands, in drinks and in various other article of enjoyments.

sa: तापसा ऊचुः ग्राहाः पञ्च वसन्त्येषु हरन्ति च तपोधनान्। तत एतानि वय॑न्ते तीर्थानि कुरुनन्दन।॥
