en: The Celestial said : O descendant of Kuru, there dwell (in their waters) five large crocodiles which carry away the ascetics (who go to bathe in them); therefore these Tirthas are shunned by all.

sa: नावमानं कुलस्यास्य गुडाकेशः प्रयुक्तवान्। सम्मानोऽभ्यधिकस्तेन प्रयुक्तोऽयं न संशयः॥
en: Gudakesha (Arjuna) has not insulted our family by what he has done. There is no doubt he has enhanced our glory.

sa: ततोऽग्नि खाण्डवं दग्धुमायान्तं दृष्टवानृषिः। मन्दपालश्चरंस्तस्मिन् वने लपितया सह॥
en: Sometime after, the Rishi Mandapala, while wandering in the forest with Lapita, saw Agni coming towards the Khandava to burn it.

sa: कच्चिदात्ययिकं श्रुत्वा तदर्थमनुचिन्त्य च। प्रियाण्यनुभवच्छेषे न त्वमन्त:पुरे नृप॥
en: O king, hearing of any danger, and even reflecting over it, do you lic in the innerapartinents and enjoy luxury there?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ऋषेस्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा निशश्वास युधिष्ठिरः। चिन्तयन् राजसूयेष्टिं न लेभे शर्म भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said O descendant of Bharata, having heard these words of the Rishi (Narada) Yudhishthira heaved sight. Full of the thought of the Rajasuya, (sacrifice), the king did not get any peace of mind.

sa: गृहे गृहे हि राजानः स्वस्य स्वस्य प्रियंकराः। न च साम्राज्यमाप्तास्ते सम्राट्छन्दो हि कृच्छ्रभाक्॥
en: There are kings in every province engaged in doing good to their respective selves. But none of them has been able to become an Emperor. The title of Emperor is difficult to be achieved.

sa: राक्षस्युवाच जरा नामास्मि भद्रं ते राक्षसी कामरूपिणी। तव वेश्मनि राजेन्द्र पूजिता न्यवसं सुखम्॥
en: The Rakshasi said O king of kings, be blessed, I am a Rakshasas woman, called Jara. I am capable of going everywhere at will. Worshipped by all, I live in your house in joy.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा जरासंधो भीमसेनमरिंदमः। प्रत्युद्ययौ महातेजाः शक्रं बल इवासुरः॥
en: Having said this, the greatly effulgent Jarasandha, that chastiser of foes, rushed at Bhimasena like the Asura Bala at Shakra (Indra).

sa: न स सज्जति वृक्षेषु शस्त्रैश्चापि न रिष्यते। दिव्यो ध्वजवरो राजन् दृश्यते चेह मानुषैः॥
en: O king, such was that celestialsly made and the best flagstaff that it never struck against a tree. The weapons could not any way injure it, although it was visible to the human eye.

sa: सोऽविषह्यतमं मत्वा कौन्तेयं पर्वतेश्वरः। उपावर्तत दुर्धर्षो रत्नान्यादाय सर्वशः॥
en: Thinking that the son of Kunti was incapable of being withstood, that invincible mountain-king came to him with all his wealth.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नं ततः क्रुद्धो बाणवधैरपीडयत्। द्रौपदेयांश्च शकुनिर्यमौ च द्रौणिरभ्ययात्॥
en: Excited with anger, Kripa struck Dhrishtadyumna with numberless arrows. Shakuni rushed against the sons of Draupadi and Ashvathaman against the twins.

sa: एकोऽप्येषां महाराज समर्थः संनिवारणे। समरे पाण्डवेयानां संक्रुद्धो ह्यभिधावताम्॥
en: Even one amongst these, O king, worked up with anger, is able to resist in battle the Pandavas rushing towards him!

sa: वित्रस्ताश्चाभवन् सर्वे कौरवा राजसत्तम। शङ्खशब्देन तेनाथ माधवस्यार्जुनस्य च॥
en: At the blare of Madhava's conch as well as that of Arjuna's all the Kauravas, O king, were stricken with fear.

sa: पञ्चालानां कुरूणां च विनाशे मधुसूदन। पञ्चानामपि भूतानामहं वधमचिन्तयम्॥
en: With the destruction of the Panchalas and the Kurus, O slayer of Madhu, I think, the five elements have been destroyed.

sa: कृपश्च कृतवर्मा च सौबलश्च महारथः॥ अयोधयन् धर्मराजं मद्रराजपुरस्कृताः।
en: Kripa and Kritavarman and the powerful son of Subala, placing the king of the Madras before them, fought with king Yudhishthira.

sa: तस्यास्यान्नासिकाभ्यां च श्रवणाभ्यां च. सर्वशः। तेभ्यश्चाक्षिसहस्रेभ्यः प्रादुरासन महार्चिषः॥
en: From those blazing flames of fire came out of his mouth and nose and ears and all those thousand of eyes.

sa: कोसलानामाधिपत्यं सम्प्राप्तं क्षेमदशि मुनिः कालकवृक्षीय आजगामेति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard that once on a time the sage Kalakavrikshiya came to Kshemadarshin, who had ascended the throne of Koshala.

sa: हृष्टेन राजन् कुरुसत्तमस्य क्षुद्रात्मना भीमसेनेन पादम्। दृष्ट्वा कृतं मूर्धनि नाभ्यनन्दन् धर्मात्मानः सोमकानां प्रबर्हाः॥
en: Seeing the foot of the rejoicing but mean Bhimasena placed upon the head of that foremost one Kuru's race, many of the leading warriors among the Somakas did not a all approve of it.

sa: संनद्धः सगदो राजन् सज्जः संग्राममूर्धनि। अब्रवीत् पाण्डवान् सर्वान् पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव॥ भ्रातृणां भवतामेको युध्यतां गदया मया। सहदेवेन वा योत्स्ये भीमेन नकुलेन वा॥ अथवा फाल्गुनेनाद्य त्वया वा भरतर्षभ। योत्स्येऽहं संगरं प्राप्य विजेष्ये च रणाजिरे॥
en: Clad in amour, armed with mace and accoutered with other equipments your son Duryodhana then, O king, standing on the field of battle, addressed all the Pandavas, saying-"Amongst you five brothers let any one fight me, armed with mace. As regards myself, I ain willing to fight either Sahadeva or Bhima or Nakula or Phalguna or you today, O best of Bharata's race. If you give me battle, I will fight any one amongst you and will surely gain the victory on the field.

sa: त्रितो यज्ञेषु कुशलस्त्रितो वेदेषु निष्ठितः॥ अन्यास्तु बहुला गावस्त्रितः
en: They said-"Trita is a clever priest. Trita is well read in the Vedas. Trita is capable of earning many other kine.

sa: ते समासाद्य समरे परस्परमरिंदमाः। व्यनदंश्चैव जघ्नुश्च समासाद्य महाहवे।॥
en: Belonging to both armies and encountering one another, those chastisers of foes struck and killed one another in that dreadful battle.

sa: प्रणिपत्य हि राजानं राज्यं यदि लभेमहि। श्रेयः स्यान्न तु मौढ्येन राजन् गन्तुः पराभवम्॥
en: If by submission to king Yudhishthira we may still have the kingdom even that would be for our good and not O king, to suffer through folly defeat at the hand of the Pandavas.

sa: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य प्रनिघ्नन् सव्यसाचिनः। चक्रे चाप्यधिकं पार्थात् स्ववीर्यमतिदर्शयन्॥
en: Radha's son, however, nullified all the arrows of Savyasachin. With his power he got better of Arjuna for the time being.

sa: मुनिरुवाच वयं तु ब्राह्मणा नाम मृदुदण्डाः कृपालवः। स्वस्ति चेच्छाम भवतः परेषां च यथाऽऽत्मनः॥
en: As regards ourselves, we are Brahmanas, by nature merciful and reluctant to give pain to any one. We desire your, as well as of others, well-being, even as we wish the good of ourselves.

sa: अथोवाच हृषीकेशं पाण्डुपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। नान्यस्तु देवकीपुत्राच्छक्तः प्रष्टुं पितामहम्॥
en: Then Yudhishthira the son of Pandu, addressing Hrishikesha, said,-"There is no one else then Devaki's son who can question the grandfather.

sa: योगयुक्ता महात्मानः सततं ब्राह्मणप्रियाः। पैतामहा महात्मानो महापारिषदाश्च ये॥
en: Besides these many other great and powerful companions, practising ascetic austerities and respecting Brahmanas, were given to him by the grandfather,

sa: तेषु राजन् निवृत्तेषु व्यूढानीकेषु भागशः। प्रावर्तत महारौद्रः संग्रामः शोणितोदकः॥ समाळुचित्रसेनं तु नकुलो युद्धदुर्मदः।
en: After they had come back, O king and separately taken up their positions in a wellformed array, an awful encounter took place in which blood flowed freely like water. The invincible Nakula encountered Chitrasena.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु पाण्डवाः सर्वे मातुर्वचनमप्रियम्॥ कर्णमेवानुशोचन्तो भूयः क्लान्ततराभवन्।
en: Hearing these painful words of their mother, the Pandavas began to grieve for Karna. Indeed, they became more afflicted then ever.

sa: एवं ते प्रययुर्वीरा वीक्षमाणाः परस्परम्। भयार्ताः पाण्डुपुत्राणामागस्कृत्वा महात्मनाम्॥
en: Thus those heroes, who had offended the great sons of Pandu, respectively proceeded to the places they selected, on one another.

sa: बहुसंकुसुकं दृष्ट्वा विधित्सासाधनेन च। तथान्ये संत्यजन्त्येव मत्वा परमदुर्लभम्॥
en: Others, considering earthly possessions to be exceedingly unstable and unobtainable, and dependent upon continued exertion, are also scen to renounce it.

sa: वानप्रस्थं भक्ष्यचर्यं गार्हस्थ्यं च महाश्रमम्। ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमं प्राहुश्चतुर्थं ब्राह्मणैर्वृतम्॥
en: The four modes and Vanaprastha (hermit), Bhaikshya (mendicant), Garhasthya of great merit (house-holder), Brahmacharya (religious student) which is adopted by Brahmanas.

sa: विरथं सात्यकि कृत्वा मद्रराजो महारथः। विशिखानां शतैनैनमाजघान समन्ततः॥
en: Having made Satyaki carless, that great carwarrior, the king of the Madras, struck him with a hundred arrows from all sides.

sa: उताहो नाममात्रं वै सुवर्णष्ठीविनोऽभवत्। कथं वा काञ्चनष्ठीवीत्येतदिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: Or, was he in name only Suvarnashthivin? How also did he come to be so! I wish to know all this?

sa: विशालान् राजमार्गाश्च कारयीत नराधिपः। प्रपाश्च विपणांश्चैव यथोद्देशं समाविशेत्॥
en: The king should have wide roads constructed, and open up shops, and places for the distribution of water, at proper stations.

sa: संक्षेपो नीतिशास्त्राणामविश्वासः परो मतः॥ नृषु तस्मादविश्वास: पुष्कलं हितमात्मनः।
en: In short, the highest truth of all works on policy is Mistrust. Therefore, mistrust of all persons yields the greatest good.

sa: स च्छाद्यमानः समरे धर्मपुत्रस्य सायकैः॥ युधिष्ठिरमथाविध्यद् दशभिर्निशितैः शरैः।
en: Thus covered in that battle by the son of Dharma with his arrows Shalya struck the former with ten keen arrows.

sa: प्रदिक्षिणमभूत् सर्वं धर्मराजस्य युध्यतः। ततः शरशतं शल्यो मुमोचाथ युधिष्ठिरे॥ धनुश्चास्य शिताग्रेण बाणेन निरकृन्तत।
en: King Yudhishthira, in the course of that battle, placed his enemy to his right. Then Shalya shot a century of best arrows, at Yudhisthira. With another sharp arrow, he cut off the latter's bow.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वां उपदेशं चकार सः॥ विधिं च योगस्य परं कार्याकार्यस्य शास्त्रतः।
en: Hearing these words of his, Jaigishavya gave him lessons. And he also initiated him in the mysteries of Yoga and taught him the all important and obligatory duties of individuals as also their reverses.

sa: यस्माददान्तान् दमयत्यशिष्टान् दण्डयत्यपि। दमनाद् दण्डनाच्चैव तस्माद् दण्डं विदुर्बुधाः॥
en: The rod of chastisement (Danda) has been so designated by the wise, because it governs the ungovernable and punishes the wicked.

sa: अयमत्यन्तशत्रुर्मे वैषम्यं परमं गतः। मूढो ग्राहयितुं स्वार्थं सङ्गत्या यदि शक्यते॥ कदाचिद् व्यसनं प्राप्य संधि कुर्यान्मया सह!
en: The cat is my great enemy, but the danger into which he has fallen is very great. Let me see if I can make this foolish creature understand his own interests. Having fallen into such difficulty he may make peace with me.

sa: रूपेणाप्सरसां तुल्या मनोहार्यो मनोरमाः॥ परपुष्टोपमा वाक्ये तथा धनदोपमाः।
en: Of handsome and delightful features, they were beautiful like the Assuras. In voice they resembled the kokila and it walth, Kuvera.

sa: केचिदेनं व्यवस्यन्ति पितामहसुतं प्रभुम्। सनत्कुमारं सर्वेषां ब्रह्मयोनि तमग्रजम्॥
en: Some spoke of him as the powerful son of the Grandsire, viz., Sanatkumara, the eldest of all the sons of Brahman.

sa: न येषामस्ति संस्कर्ता न च येऽत्राहिताग्नयः। वयं च कस्य कुर्याम बहुत्वात् तात कर्मणाम्॥
en: What shall we do with those that have none to look after them and that have no sacred fires? We have many duties to perform. Who are those whose (funeral) rites we should perform?

sa: ये तु प्राज्ञाः स्थिताः सत्त्वे संसारेऽस्मिन् हितैषिणः। समागमज्ञा भूतानां ते यान्ति परमां गतिम्॥
en: They, however, that are wise, virtuous and desirous of doing good to all living creatures, who are acquainted with the real nature of beings in this world, attain at last to the highest end."

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय नकुलः क्रोधमूर्छितः॥ सुषेण पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा ध्वजमेकेन चिच्छिदे।
en: Then Nakula, beside himself with rage, took up another bow and struck Sushena with five arrows and his standard with one.

sa: ततश्चिच्छेद तं पाशं मार्जारस्य च मूषिकः॥ विप्रमुक्तोऽथ मार्जारस्तमेवाभ्यपतद् दुमम्। स तस्मात् सम्भ्रमावर्तान्मुक्तो घोरेण शत्रुणा॥ बिलं विवेश पलितः शाखां लेभे स लोमशः।
en: The mouse very quickly cut the remaining string which held fast that cat. Freed from the noose, the cat run quickly and got upon the banian. Palita also, freed from that perilous position and from the presence of a terrible enemy quickly fled and entered his hole. Lomasha meanwhile had got upon the high tree.

sa: अथापराह्ने तस्याह्नः परिवार्य सुयोधनः। ह्रदादाहूय युद्धाय भीमसेनेन पतितः॥
en: Then on that afternoon causing the lake to be encircled by mighty warriors Bhimasena invited him for battle and killed him.

sa: ततः स्वयंवरे तस्मिन् सम्प्रवृत्ते महोत्सवे। समाजग्मुर्नृपतयः कन्यार्थे नृपसत्तम॥
en: When the festivities commenced in that Svayamvara various kings, O best of kings, came there for the hand of the maiden.

sa: सतां वै ददतोऽन्नं च लोकेऽस्मिन् प्रकृतिर्बुवा। न चेद् राजा भवेद् दाता कुतः स्युर्मोक्षकाक्षिणः।।२७
en: In this world, the food given by a charitable person, is the support of the pious. If, therefore, the king does not give (food), where will the pious go to, who aspire for salvation.

sa: तद् युद्धमभवचित्रं घोररूपं च मारिष॥ प्रेक्षतां प्रीतिजननं सिद्धचारणसेवितम्।
en: That battle presented a wonderful spectacle, It filled the spectators with delight and was praised by the Siddhas and the Charanas.

sa: कर्णिनालीकनाराचैरास्तीर्य शयनोत्तमम्। आविश्य शेते भगवान् स्कन्दः शरवणं यथा॥
en: Having spread his bed of barbed and unbarbed arrows, that hero lieth on it like Skanda on a clump of reeds.

sa: नरनारायणौ देवौ कथितौ नारदेन मे। धर्मात्मानौ महात्मानौ पुराणावृषित्तमौ॥
en: Narada told me that you two are the two foremost of divine Rishis Nara and Narayana ever engaged in maintaining virtue.

sa: कम्पमानेव कदली वातेनाभिसमीरिता। कृष्णा राजानमासाद्य शोकार्ता न्यपतद् भुवि॥
en: Trembling like a plantain tree shaken by the wind, the princes Krishna, arrived before Yudhishthira, and fell down afflicted with sorrow.

sa: अनीकयोः संहतयोर्यदीयाद् ब्राह्मणोऽन्तरा। शान्तिमिच्छन्नुभयतो न योद्धव्यं तदा भवेत्॥
en: If a Brahmana, with a view to secure peace, fearlessly intervenes between the two contending armies, both should immediately stop fighting.

sa: निहतेषु च शूरेषु मद्रराजानुगेषु वै। अस्मानापततश्चापि दृष्ट्वा पार्था महारथाः॥ अभ्यवर्तन्त वेगेन जयगृद्धाः प्रहारिणः।
en: When the brave followers of the Madra king were killed the great car-warriors of the Parthas, beholding a body of horse advancing towards them, rushed quickly towards it with a view to win victory.

sa: दत्त्वाऽतिथिभ्यो देवेभ्यः पितृभ्यः स्वजनाय च। अवशिष्टानि येऽश्नन्ति तानाहुर्विघसाशिनः॥
en: They are called eaters of the residue of feasts who cat after having fed guests and gods and Rishis and kinsmen.

sa: तेषां वृत्यर्थिना तत्र वसतां हिमवद्वने॥ अनावृष्टिरनुप्राप्ता तदा द्वादशवार्षिकी।
en: While they thus lived in a forest of Himavat for procuring their food, a drought took place extending for twelve years.

sa: यया कैलासभवने महेश्वरसखं वली। आह्वयामास युद्धाय भीमसेनो महाबलः॥
en: With this mace, the powerful son of Kunti had, in Kailasa, challenged the enraged Lord of Alaka, the friend of Maheshvara.

sa: स्तलान् निजघ्नुः सिंहनादांश्च नेदुः॥ सर्वे ह्यमन्यन्त वशे कृतौ तौ कर्णेन कृष्णाविति ते विम।
en: Then your troops, believing that Karna has brought Krishna and Arjuna under subjection, thought the great victory to theirs and loudly clapped their hands and gave vent to roars like that of a lion.

sa: कालेन शीघ्राः प्रवहन्ति वाता: कालेन वृष्टिर्जलदानुपति। कालेन पद्मोत्पलवज्जलं च कालेन पुष्यन्ति वनेषु वृक्षाः॥
en: By time the winds blow violently; by Time the clouds become surcharged with rain; by Time tanks become adorned with lotuses of various sorts; by Time trees in the forest are covered with flowers.

sa: तेषां कामदुधालँ लोकानिन्द्रः संकल्पयिष्यति। इन्द्रस्यातिथयो ोते भवन्ति भरतर्षभ।१५।।
en: forsooth, Indra will give them regions capable of granting every wish. These, O foremost of men, become the guests of Indra.

sa: इति वाचा मधुरया श्लक्ष्णया सोपचारया। स्वरश्मीनभ्यवसृजेद् योगमाधाय कालवित्॥
en: A king knowing Time should, with such agreeable, sweet, and complimentary words, send his agents and make collections from his subjects.

sa: नाश्वेन रथिनं यायादुदियाद् रथिनं रथी। व्यसने न प्रहर्तव्यं न भीताय जिताय च॥ इषुर्लिप्तो न कर्णी स्यादसतामेतदायुधम्।
en: One should not on horse-back run against a car-warrior. A car-warrior should fight with a car-warrior. When an antagonist is in a bad plight, he should not be struck; nor should one who has been frightened, nor one who has been defeated.

sa: नेत्राभ्यां सरुजाभ्यां यः प्रतिवातमुदीक्षते। तस्य वायुरुन्दात्यर्थं नेत्रयोर्भवति ध्रुवम्॥
en: By opening his eyes against the wind, a man, who has got sore ejus, finds them greatly pained by the wind.

sa: अथ धर्मस्तथैवार्थः श्रीश्च राज्ये प्रतिष्ठिता। सुकृतस्य क्षयाच्चैव स्वर्लोकादेत्य मेदिनीम्॥ पार्थिवो जायते तात दण्डनीतिविशारदः। महत्त्वेन च संयुक्तो वैष्णवेन नरो भुवि॥ बुद्ध्या भवति संयुक्तो माहात्म्यं चाधिगच्छति।
en: All the three, viz., Dharma and Artha and Sree, were established in a king. A person, upon the wane of his merit, descends from heaven to Earth, and is born as a king well read in the science of punishment. Such a person becomes great and is really a portion of Vishnu on Earth. He becomes highly intelligent and obtains superiority over others.

sa: दीप्ताश्च वातः प्रवर्नीचैः शर्करकर्षिणः। गिरीणां शिखराण्येव न्यपतन्त महीतले॥
en: Hot winds blew, carrying showers of hard pebbles along the ground. The summits of mountains dropped down on the Earth's surfacc.

sa: शोकस्थानसहस्राणि भयस्थानशतानि च। दिवसे दिवसे मूढमाविशन्ति च पण्डितम्॥
en: Thousands of causes spring up daily for sorrow and thousands for fear. These, however, affect the ignorant and not the wise.

sa: एवमेतानि दुःखानि तानि तानीह मानवम्। विविधान्युपवर्तन्ते तथा संस्पर्शजान्यपि॥
en: All these various kinds of misery as also those arising from attachment to earthly pleasures that overtake man, are even such.

sa: ततः प्रादादनुचरौ यमः कालोपमावुभौ। उन्माथश्च प्रमाथश्च महावी? महाद्युती॥
en: Then Yama gave him two companions, both of whom resembled Death, viz., Unmatha and Pramatha, endued with great energy and splendour.

sa: ततस्तेषां विधातव्यं सर्वमेवाप्रमादतः। भक्तान् पूजयता नित्यं द्विषतश्च निगृह्णता॥
en: He should then, carefully, concert his own measures, honouring those that are loyal to him and chastising those that are hostile.

sa: दुर्योधनं परीप्सन्तस्तत्र तत्र युधिष्ठिरम्। अन्वयुस्त्वरितास्ते वै राजानं श्रान्तवाहनाः॥
en: Although their animals were exhausted all of them still proceeded quickly behind king Yudhishthira who was determined upon finding out Duryodhana.

sa: ध्वजवन्तोऽस्त्रवन्तश्च शस्त्रवन्तस्तथैव च॥ प्राकम्पन्त ततो राजंस्तव पुत्रे निपातिते।
en: Warriors, O king, who stood with standards or weapons in their arms, began to tremble, O king, when your son fell.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनं द्वादशभी रुक्मपुङ्खैः सुतेजनैः॥ वासुदेवं च दशभिद्रौणिर्विव्याध भारत।
en: The son of Drona then, O Bharata, struck Arjuna with a dozen of powerful gold winged arrows and Vasudeva with ten.

sa: द्रौणिमुक्ताञ्छरांस्तांस्तु तद् भूतं महदग्रसत्। उदधेरिव वार्यघान् पावको वडवामुखः॥
en: Like the Vadava fire devouring the waters of the ocean, that being devoured the arrows discharged by the son of Drona.

sa: अजयन्त रणे शत्रून् हर्षयन्तो नरेश्वरम्। तस्मादात्मवता नित्यं स्थातव्यं रणमूर्धनि॥ इत्युक्तास्ते नृपतिना योधाः परपुरंजय॥
en: Thus addressed by their king, O subduer of hostile towns, the warriors of Mithila, pleasing their king, defeated their enemies in battle. The strong-minded people should take their stand in the van of battle.

sa: अध्यायानां सहस्रस्तु त्रिभिरेव बृहस्पतिः। संचिक्षेपेश्वरो बुद्ध्या बार्हस्पत्यं तदुच्यते॥
en: Afterwards the powerful Brihaspati, by his intelligence, further abridged the work, into one containing three thousand chapters and named it Barhaspatya.

sa: अमर्षी चपलश्चापि क्रोधनो दुष्प्रसाधनः॥ दैवयोगात् समुत्पन्ना भ्रातरश्चास्य तादृशाः।
en: He was vindictive, restless, wrathful and difficult of being pleased. Through the influence of Destiny his brothers also took after him.

sa: सहदेवस्ततः क्रुद्धो निरमित्रं महाहवे। जघान पृतनामध्ये भल्लेन परवीरहा॥
en: Thereat the enraged Sahadeva, that slayer of hostile heroes, in that fierce battle, slew Niramitra with a broad-headed shaft, O prince.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं नरवारणवाजिनाम्। रथानां च महाराज अन्योन्यमभिनिघ्नताम्॥
en: 'O nighty monarch, thus commenced the battle of men, elephants, horses and cars, who were all engaged in slaying one another.

sa: हाहाकारस्ततस्तीव्रः सम्बभूव जनेश्वर॥ वध्यमानेषु वीरेषु तव पुत्रेषु धान्विषु।
en: O king, when those your heroic sons, great bowmen, were being thus killed people began to send loud cried of lamentations.

sa: राधेयस्याद्य पापस्य भूमि: पास्यति शोणितम्॥ सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि हतं विद्ध्यद्य सूतजम्। यस्येच्छसि वधं तस्य गतमप्यस्य जीवितम्॥
en: Today the earth shall soak the blood of that reprobate son of Radha; solemnly I swear before you that you may count upon Suta's son as slain today and know it for certain that whomever you like, he loses his life today.

sa: न हि कार्यमकार्यं वा सुखं ज्ञातु कथंचन। श्रुतेन ज्ञायते सर्व तच त्वं नावबुध्यसे॥
en: 'It is not easy to learn what ought to be done and what ought not. Of course everything can be learnt with the help of the scriptures. You are, however, a stranger to them.

sa: ततो विसस्त्रः पुनपर्दिता नरा नरोत्तमाभ्यां कुरुपाण्डवाश्रयः॥ सनागपत्तयश्वरथा दिशो दश तथा यथा सिंहहता वनौकसः।
en: And like the smaller animals when attacked by a lion the Kurus and Pandus together with their horses, elephants and car warriors fled on all directions being assailed by those two best of men.

sa: अधान्यद् धनुरादाय सहदेवः प्रतापवान्। दुःशासनाय चिक्षेप बाणमन्तकरं ततः॥
en: Thereupon Shahadeva, possessed of immerise prowess, having taken up another bow, hurled at Dushasana a shaft, capable of bringing about death.

sa: रथशक्तिभिरन्योन्यं विशिग्वैश्चाप्यकृन्तताम्। निर्भिन्दन्तौ हि गात्राणि विक्षरन्तौ च शोणितम्॥
en: With lances and with darts and javelins they inflicted wounds on each other. They mangled their bodies and shed blood profusely.

sa: मा व्यथां कुरु राधेय नैव त्वय्युपपद्यते॥ एते द्रवन्ति राजानो भीमसेनभयार्दिताः। दुर्योधनश्च सम्मूढो भ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितः॥
en: "O son of Radha, do not be depressed, it is not fit for you; ail the chiefs are dispersing themselves afraid of Bhimasena. Duryodhana is confounded owing to the woeful fate of his brothers.

sa: वृषभस्य स्थितो मूर्ध्नि हयपृष्ठे त मानद। तदा स भगवान् रुद्रो निरैक्षद् दानवं पुरम्॥
en: O giver of honors, while that illustrious lord Rudra was thus standing at the head of his bull and ou the back of his horses, then he beheld the city belonging to the Danavas.

sa: त्वरन् समावृणोद् बाणैर्दुःशासनममित्रजित्। दृष्टा दुःशासनं राजा तथा शरशताचितम्॥
en: with rage. Beholding Dushasana thus covered by the shafts of Satyaki, king Duryodhana urged the Trigarttas towards the car of Yuyudhana.

sa: सुरैरवध्याः संग्रामे तेन वीरेण निर्जिताः। दानवानां सहस्राणि हिरण्यपुरवासिनाम्॥
en: Unslayable by the gods themselves in battle, were also vanquished by that hero. Thousands of Danavas dallying in the golden city.

sa: यथौघः पर्वतश्चेष्ठमासाद्याभिप्रदीर्यते॥ तथा तत् पाण्डवं सैन्यं कर्णमासाद्य दीर्यते।
en: And like a stream dividing itself when checked by a mountain, so did the Pandava forces break themselves opposed by Karna.

sa: युद्धाभिलाषुको भूत्वा ध्वजो गाण्डीवधन्वनः। कर्णध्वजमुपातिष्ठत् स्वस्थानाद् वेगवान् कपिः॥ उत्पपात महावेगः कक्ष्यामध्याहनत्तदा। नखैश्च दशनैश्चैव गरुडः पन्नगं यथा॥
en: The ape, on the banner of Gandiva, being willing to fight all on sudden, left his place, lept upon Karna's banner, like Gadura swooping down upon a snake and began to tear the elephant rope standard fiercely with its nails and teeth.

sa: दुर्योधनः समालक्ष्य धर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्॥ प्रोवाच सूतं त्वरितो याहि याहीति भारत। तत्र मां प्रापय क्षिप्रं सारथे यत्र पाण्डव॥ ध्रियमाणातपत्रेण राजा राजति दंशितः।
en: Do you proceed, do you proceed, quickly. After he, O descendant of the Bharata race, had beheld Yudhishthira, the king of righteousness, he said-"O charioteer, most speedily do you lead me to that place, where the royal son of Pandu, having been clad in armour, looks most resplendent with the umbrella held over his head."

sa: अक्षौहिण्यस्तथा तिस्त्रो धार्तराष्ट्रस्य संहता। क्रुद्धेन भीमसेनेन नरसिंहने वारिताः॥
en: Three Akshauhini of Dhritarashtra's soldiers have been arranged and they all have been thwarted by angry Bhima, the foremost of men.

sa: स पुनर्भरतश्रेष्ठ क्रोधादुद्भान्तलोचनः। तलं तलेन संहत्य संदश्य दशनच्छदम्॥
en: O best of the Bharatas, again he (i.e., Ghatotkacha), with eyes rolling in rage, striking his palms and biting his lip.

sa: ते यूयं धर्ममुत्सृज्य जयं रक्षत पाण्डवाः। यथा वः संयुगे सर्वान् न हन्याद् रुक्मवाहनः॥
en: Therefore disregarding the rules of fair combat do you strive for the sake of giving victory to the Pandavas, in such a manner that he of the golden car may not slay you all.

sa: तावुभौ नरशार्दूलौ युयुधाते परस्परम्। महावने तीव्रमदौ वारणाविव यूथयौ॥
en: Then those two foremost of inen fought on with each other like two elephant leaders in rut, in a deep wood.

sa: द्रोणं शरैर्विव्यधतुः परमं क्रोधमास्थितौ। ततो द्रोणो महाराज क्रोधामर्षसमन्वितः॥
en: Those two heroes began to afflict Drona wrathfully in that battle. O mighty monarch, therefore, Drona filled with rage and fury.

sa: आसीद् राजन् वलौघानामन्योन्यमभिनिघ्नताम्। विव्याध सोमदत्तस्तु सात्वतं नवभिः शरैः॥
en: There arose, O king, a great tumult among the (two) forces striking each other. Somadatta then pierced Satvata with nine arrows.

sa: अन्ये चान्वपतन् द्रोणं त्यक्तात्मानो महौजसः। पञ्चालास्तु विशेषेण द्रोणसायकपीडिताः॥
en: Other warriors, of controlled passions and great might, fell upon Drona. Specially the Panchalas, though afflicted with the shafts of Drona.

sa: तथा तमनुधावन्तं युयुधानस्य पृष्ठतः॥ न्यवारयन्त संहृष्टाः पाण्डुसैन्ये वृहत्तमाः।
en: Then beholding Drona follow Yuyudhana from behind, the foremost warriors among the Kurus filled with delight began to impede his progress.

sa: पञ्चालास्त्वेकतो द्रोणमभ्यघ्नन् पाण्डवैः सह। दुर्योधनश्च कर्णश्च शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः॥
en: The Panchalas attacked Drona from one side whilst the Pandavas attacked him from the other. Then Duryodhana, Karna, Subala's son Sakuni.

sa: तावन्ये धनुषी सज्ये कृत्वा शत्रुभयंकरे। युयुधानमविध्येतां समन्तान्निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Piercing Karna with ten and Vrishasena with five shafts, the Satvata hero then cut-off their bow as well as their gloves.

sa: सोदर्याश्च यथामुख्यास्तेऽरक्षन् द्रोणमाहवे। रक्ष्यमाणं तथा द्रोणं सर्वैस्तैस्तु महारथैः॥ यतमानास्तु पञ्चाला न शेकुः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्। तत्राक्रुध्यद् भीमसेनो धृष्टद्युम्नस्य मारिष॥ स एनं वाग्भिरुग्राभिस्ततक्ष पुरुषर्षभः।
en: And his other principal uterine brothers began to protect Drona in battle. Then the Panchalas, though striving hard, could not even look at Drona who was then being thus protected in battle by those high-souled warriors. Thereupon, O sire, Bhimasena became enraged with Dhistadyumna and then addressed that foremost of men in these harsh words.

sa: पञ्चारां विदेहांश्च कुलिन्दान् काशिकोसलान्। सुह्यानङ्गांश्च वङ्गांश्च निषादान् पुण्ड्रचीरकान्॥
en: And the Panchalas, the Videhas, the Kulindas, the Kashi-Kosalas, the Suhmas, the Angas, the Bangas, the Nishadhas, the Pundras, the Kichakas.

sa: ततस्तस्य नरेन्द्रस्य पुत्रमूर्धनि भूतले। गते तस्यापि शतधा मूर्धागच्छदरिंदम॥ ततः सर्वाणि सैन्यानि विस्मयं जग्मुरुत्तमम्।
en: And as the head of that king's son fell down on earth. The head of that king also was cracked into thousand pieces, subduer of foes. Then all creatures were greatly filled with wonder.

sa: दुर्मर्षणो दुःसहश्च दुर्मदो दुर्धरो जयः। पाण्डवं चित्रसंनाहास्तं प्रतीपमुपाद्रवन्॥
en: Namely, Durmarsena, Dussaha, Durmada, Durdhara and Jaya, all clad in beautiful armours, rushed against the son of Pandu with hostile intentions.

sa: पार्थश्च पुरुषव्याघ्रः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। जघान् धार्तराष्ट्रस्य चतुर्विधबलां चमूम्॥
en: Lion heart Partha killed the Caturangini army (infantry, chariot-rider, horse-riders and elephant-riders) led by Duryodhana by shooting arrows with bent nodes.

sa: तमायान्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य तव पुत्रं महामृधे॥ प्रत्युद्ययुः समुदिताः पञ्चाला जयगृद्धिनः।
en: Then beholding your son rush to battle with fury, the Panchalas always intent on securing victory received him with delight. son

sa: बभूव रजनीमुखे। घोरचटचटाशब्दः शस्राणां पततामभूत्। मृदङ्गानकनि दैर्झर्झरैः पटहैस्तथा॥
en: There arose a dreadful clanging noise of the clashing weapons. In consequence of the sounds of Mridangas, Anakas, Vallakis and Patahas.

sa: ते हयाः साध्वशोभन्त मिश्रिता वातरंहसः। पारावतसवर्णाश्च रक्तशोणाश्च संयुगे॥
en: Those pegion-white and crimson steeds, endued with the fleetness of the wind, appeared extremely beautiful, being mingled together in that battle.

sa: दुर्जयं भिन्नमर्माणमनयद् यमसादनम्। स्वलंकृतं क्षितौ क्षुण्णं चेष्टमानं यथोरगम्॥
en: Then Karna lamenting piteously circumambulated your son who decked with ornaments was then writhing like a slain snake on the earth.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महाबाहुपदो बुद्धिमान् नृप। लुब्धोऽयं क्षत्रियान् हन्ति व्याघ्रः क्षुद्रमृगानिव॥
en: His adversaries considered him to be none other than Indra himself armed with the thunder. Then, O king, the intelligent, Drupada

sa: तं स्वयं प्रतिगृह्याथ भगवान् स वरं ददौ। ववे पिता मे परममा नारायणं ततः॥
en: Accepting those offerings that possessor of the six illustrious qualities (the Bhagas) desired to accord a boon to my sire. Thereupon my father asked the boon of getting that most excellent weapon called Narayana.

sa: द्रोणे हते कौरवार्थं व्यक्तमभ्येति वासवः। प्रहृष्टरोमकूपाश्च संविग्ना रथपुङ्गवाः॥
en: ( Dhananjaya, hearing this loud and terrible sound our hairs stand erect and our best car-warriors are becoming filled with anxiety.

sa: तानि दुःखान्यनेकानि विप्रकारंश्च सर्वशः। हृदि कृत्वा महाबाहुर्रमोऽयुध्यत सूतजम्॥
en: Bearing in mind all those hardships and all other insults offered to the Pandavas, the mighty-armed Bhima fought with Suta's son.

sa: तत्रापश्यंस्तव सुता भीमसेनस्य विक्रमम्। सुपुङ्खैः कङ्कवासोभिर्यत् कर्ण छादयच्छरैः॥ स नन्दयन् रणे पार्थ केशवं च यशस्विनम्। सात्यकिं चक्ररक्षौ च भीमः कर्णमयोधयत्॥ विक्रमं भुजयोर्वीर्य धैर्य च विदितात्मनः। पुत्रास्तव महाराज दृष्ट्वा विमनसोऽभवन्॥
en: Then your sons beheld the prowess of Bhimasena, when he covered Karna with arrows decked with beautiful wings made of the feathers of the Kanka bird. Thus then Bhima fought on with Karna, affording delight there by to Arjuna and the illustrious Keshava and Satyaki and his two protectors of carwheels. Then your sons, O mighty monarch, became depressed, seeing the prowess, the strength of arms and the patience of Bhima, who thoroughly knew his self.

sa: वरूथिनी वेगवतीं विद्रुतां सपताकिनीम्। परिगृह्य महासेनां सूतपुत्रोऽपयाद् भयात्॥
en: Taking with him his numerous divisions that were flying with all their standards, Suta's son also, out of fear, fled away.

sa: मा कर्ण राक्षसो घोरः प्रमादानाशयिष्यति। एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजञ्जटासुरसुतो बली॥
en: Let not the dreadful Rakshasa succeed, through our negligence, in slaying Karna. Meanwhile, O monarch, the highly puissant son of Jatasura.

sa: तमोरोप्य रथे राजन् दण्डधारो नराधिपमः॥ अपाहरदसम्भ्रान्तो धृष्टद्युम्नस्य पश्यतः।
en: In the very sight of Dhristadyumna. Dandadhara, taking the king upon his own car, quickly carried him away from the field.

sa: ताभ्यां दुर्योधनः सार्धमकरोत् संख्यमुत्तमम्। त्वरितस्त्वरमाणाभ्यां भ्रातृभ्यां भारतो बली॥
en: Then the mighty Duryodhana of the Bharata race quickly began a terrible fight with those two broiners endued with great activity.

sa: हतो भूरिश्रवा वीरस्तव पुत्रो महारथः। शलश्चैव महाराज भ्रातृव्यसनकर्षितः॥
en: O king, your son, the mighty car-warrior Bhurisrava has been slain. Then the heroic Shala and Vrisena too have been destroyed.

sa: द्रोणस्तु दिवमास्थाय नक्षत्रमथमाविशत्। अहमेव तदाद्राक्षं द्रोणस्य निधनं नृप॥
en: Meanwhile Drona proceeding to the heavens entered the stellar path. I only saw the (true circumstances of the) death of Drona.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य क्रुद्धं कुरुपतिं तदा। अवप्लुतौ रथोपस्थाद् युधामन्यूत्तमौजसो॥
en: Beholding that enraged subduer of hostile cities make towards themselves, Yudhamanya and Uttamoujas jumped down from the terrace of their cars.

sa: एतस्यैवं प्रवृद्धस्य सूतपुत्रस्य संयुगे। निषेद्धा विद्यते नान्यस्त्वामृते भीमविक्रम॥
en: Save yourself, O you of dreadful prowess, no one else is none who can confront Suta's son in battle thus engaged.

sa: दुःखात् सुदुःखव्यसनं प्राप्तवानस्मि संजय॥ भीष्मद्रोणवधैनैव कर्णस्य च महात्मनः।
en: O Sanjaya, on the death of Bhishma, Drona and the lofty-minded Karna, I have attained to the greatest sorrow and calamity.

sa: पुरा वैकर्तनं कर्णमेष पापो घटोत्कचः। मायाबलं समाश्रित्य कर्षयत्यरिकर्शन॥
en: O slayer of foes, allow not this sinful Ghatotkacha), to crush Vikartana's son through his illusive powers before you despatch him."

sa: कर्णस्य पुत्रं तु रथी सुषेणं समागतं संजयश्चोत्तमौजाः। गान्धारराजं सहदेवः क्षुधार्ता महर्षभं सिंह इवाभ्यधावत्॥
en: And like a hungry lion hotly pursuing a stout bull, Uttamauja, the great car-warrior of Srinjayas, pounced upon Susena, the son of Karna,; while Sahadeva launched out against Shakuni, the King of the Gandharas.

sa: बभूव रजनी घोरा भीरूणां भयवर्धिनी। योधानामशिवा रौद्रा राजन्नन्तकगामिनी॥
en: The night became dark increasing the terror of the cowards. (And) that dismal (night) O king, proved destructive of (numerous) warriors.

sa: ससैन्यास्ते न्यवर्तन्त द्रोणमेव महाद्युतिम्। प्रभद्रकाश्च पञ्चालाः षट्रसहस्राः प्रहारिणः॥
en: Followed by their own troops proceeded against the highly resplendent Drona. The Prabhadrakas and the Panchałas, numbering sixty thousand (efficient) smiters.

sa: प्रस्थला मद्रगान्धारा आरट्टा नामतः खशाः। वसातिसिन्धुसौवीरा इति प्रायोऽतिकुत्सिताः॥
en: The Prasthalas, the Madras, the Gandharvas, the Arattas, Khasas, the Vasatis, the Sindhus and the Sauviras also follow these reprehensible practices.

sa: युध्यमानं च मां हित्वा प्रदक्षिणमवर्तत। त्वं हि मे युध्यतो नाद्य जीवन् यास्यसि माधव॥
en: He avoided me though I was fighting and proceeded keeping me in the right. You shall not, escape me today with life, provided you also do not shun me fighting, like your cowardly preceptor."

sa: तं विद्धि पुरुषव्याघ्रं सात्वतं च महारथम्। स तं महारथं पश्चादनुयातस्तवानुजम्॥ तमपश्यन्महाबाहुमहं विन्दामि कश्मलम्।
en: Know him a great car-warrior and lion among the men of Sattvata race, Your younger brother followed him. I do not see him and this adds to my grief and anxiety all the more.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्य वचनं मा युध्यस्वेति सर्वदा॥ दुर्योधन नाभ्यगृह्णानमूढः पथ्यमिवौषधम्।
en: The stupid Duryodhana did not accept the constant advice of Yudhishthira viz. do not fight, which was like the wholesome drug.

sa: अम्बष्ठान् मालवाञ्छूरांस्रिगर्तान् स शिबीनापि। प्राहिणोन्मृत्युलोकाय क्रुद्धो युद्धे युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: (And) in that battle Yudhishthira sent to the region of Death, the Ambhastas, the Malavas, the heroic Trigartas and the Sivis.

sa: तत: प्रहस्य बीभत्सुद्रौणपुत्रस्य संयुगे। क्षिप्रं रश्मीनताश्वानां क्षुरप्रैश्चिच्छिदे जयः॥
en: Then smiling a little, Vibhatsu also named Jaya speedily cut-off the rein of Drouni's horses in battle with a razor-like shaft.

sa: अभीषाहाञ्छूरसेनान् बाह्रीकान् सवसातिकान्। निकृत्य पृथिवीं राजा चक्रे शोणितकर्दमाम्॥
en: Chopping off the Abhishahas, the Surasenas, the Valhikas and the Vashatikas, he made the earth muddy with (their) flesh and blood.

sa: यानन्यान् ददृशे भीमश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतान्। पुत्रांस्तव महाराज त्वरया ताञ्जघान ह॥
en: O mighty-armed one, other sons of yours, who became the objects of Bhima's sight, were slain by him in a moment,

sa: कथं च युद्धं सम्भूतं तयोः प्राणदुरोदरे। अत्र मन्ये समायत्तो जयो वाजय एव च॥
en: Tell me how the battle them raged-battle in which each staked his very life. Messems each of them was capable of conquering or each mighty have suffered defeat, (at the hand of the other).

sa: रक्षसा विप्रमुक्तस्तु कर्णोऽपि रथिनां वरः। अभ्यद्रवद् भीमसेनं रथेनादित्यवर्चसा॥
en: Meanwhile, left alone by the Rakshasa that foremost of car-warriors viz., Karna, rushed against Bhimasena, on his car of solar effulgence.

sa: यो षण्ढतिलानवोचत् सभामध्ये कौरवाणां समक्षम्। स दुर्मतिः कचिदुपेत्य संख्ये त्वया हतः सूतपुत्रो ह्यमर्षी॥
en: Did you encounter him in the field and settle with that wretched wight, the son of Suta, who had even before the assembly of the Kauravas likened us to sesame seeds devoid of Kernel;

sa: सूतपुत्रवधार्थाय शस्त्राण्यादाय सर्वशः। प्रययुः कर्णमुद्दिश्य मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: The Panchalas and the Somakas influenced by wrath, grasped their weapons with a view to compass the death of Suta's son.

sa: ततः शारद्वतीपुत्रः प्रेषयामास भारत। सुवर्णपुलाञ्छत्रुघ्नान् खचरान् खचरं प्रति॥
en: Then, O Bharata, the son of Saradvati sent gold winged and sky-ranging destructive of foes against that ranger of the sky.

sa: विनेदुः सिंहवचान्ये नदन्तो भैरवान् रवान्। बभ्रमुर्बहवो राजंश्चक्रुशुश्चापरे गजाः॥
en: Others roared like lions. And many emitting terrible sounds ran hither and thither and many, O king, uttered cries of pain.

sa: पुनः पुनस्तूबरक मूढ औदरिकेति च। अकृतास्रक मा योत्सीर्बाल संग्रामकातर॥ इति मामब्रवीत् कर्णः पश्यतस्ते धनंजय। एवं वक्ता च मे वध्यस्तेन चोक्तोऽस्मि भारत॥
en: "O Dhananjaya, in your very presence, Karna has repeatedly said to me-(you are) a eunuch, fool, child, glutton, (you are) unable to endure (the fury of) battle. He, that would tell me so, would be my victim. O Bharata, he (Karna) has said to me these words (and therefore, he must be slain by me),

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच एवमेतत् करिष्यामि यथा त्वं कर्ण मन्यसे। सोपासङ्गा रथाः साश्वाः स्वनुयास्यन्ति संयुगे॥
en: Duryodhana said I will perform all this, that you, O Karna, desire. Numerous cars, furnished with the excellent quivers and yoked to the foremost of horses, will follow you in the field of battle.

sa: ततः पुनः समाजग्मुरभीताः कुरुपाण्डवाः। युधिष्ठिरमुखाः पार्थाः सूतपुत्रमुखा वयम्॥
en: The Kurus and Pandavas once undauntedly met with each other, the former led by Karna and the latter by Yudhishthira. more

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच दैवेनोपहता यूयं स्वबुद्ध्या केशवस्य च। गता हि वासवी हत्वा तृणभूतं घटोत्कचम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said You are destroyed by Destiny, by your own understanding and by Kesava. The fatal dart of Vasava is lost having brought about the slaughter of Ghatotkacha who was insignificant as a straw.

sa: दुर्योधनस्य वीरस्य शरौघाशीघ्रमस्यतः। संक्रुद्धस्यान्तकस्येव को वेगं संसहेद् रणे॥
en: Who in battle can bear the force of arrows shot by Duryodhana, who, when worked ups with anger, resembles Death himself.

sa: प्रत्युवाच महाबाहुस्तव पुत्रमिदं वचः। सत्यमेतनमहाबाहो यथा वदसि कौरव॥
en: (And) that mighty-armed one said these words to your son. O Kaurava of mighty-arms, what you have said is indeed true.

sa: ततो भिन्नकटा नागा भिन्नकुम्भकरास्तथा॥ दुद्रुवु शतशः संख्ये भीमसेनशराहताः।
en: With their temples, frontal globes and trunks maimed the elephants, struck by Bhimasena's arrows, fled away in hundreds in that battle.

sa: तथान्यैर्विशिखैस्तूर्णं रुक्मपुत्रैः शिलाशितैः। जघानाश्वांस्तथा सूतौ पार्णी च सपदानुगौ॥
en: Then with other shafts, furnished with golden wings and whetted on stone, he quickly slew their steeds, charioteers, Parshni-drivers and followers.

sa: समाश्वस्य तु पुत्रस्ते सात्यकिं पुनरभ्ययात्। विसृजन्निषुजालानि युयुधानरथं प्रति॥ तथैव सात्यकिर्बाणान् दुर्योधनस्थं प्रति। सततं विसृजन् राजंस्तत् संकुलमवर्तत॥
en: Shooting myriad's of arrows at the chariot of the latter. Similarly Satyaki discharged arrows at Duryodhana's car; whereupon, O king, the battle became extremely fierced. Then in consequence of those shafts thus discharged and in consequence of their falling on all sides.

sa: अभिसारस्तु तं राजन् नवभिनतपर्वभिः। श्रुतकर्माणमाहत्य सूतं विव्याध पञ्चभिः॥
en: O king, Avishara, indeed, after having struck down that Shrutakarman with nine straight shafts, pierced his driver with five other arrows.

sa: यानन्यान् ददृशे भीमश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतान्। पुत्रांस्तव महाराज त्वरया ताञ्जघान ह॥
en: O mighty-armed one, other sons of yours, who became the objects of Bhima's sight, were slain by him in a moment,

sa: मम चासीन्मती राजन् दृष्ट्वा कर्णस्य विक्रमम्॥ नैकोऽप्याधिरथेर्जीवन् पाञ्चाल्यो मोक्ष्यते युधि। पञ्चालान् व्यधमत् संख्ये सूतपुत्रः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Beholding the valour of Karna, O king, I was under the impression that not even a single soul of the Panchalas would escape from the son of Adhiratha in that battle. Indeed the Suta's son repeatedly routed the Panchalas in the battle.

sa: ततः सर्वे रथास्तूर्णं पाञ्चाल्या जयगृद्धिनः। सात्वताभिसृते द्रोणे धृष्टद्युम्नमवाक्षिपन्॥
en: Then, upon the Satvata hero Satyaki advancing upon Drona, all the Panchala carwarriors, desirous of victory, extricated Dhrishtadyumna from that encounter.

sa: स ताड्यमानो विशिखैर्बहुभिस्तिग्मतेजनैः॥ सात्वतेन महाराज कृतवर्मा न चक्षमे।
en: O mighty monarch, thus pierced with numerous arrows of great fierceness by that Satvata hero, Kritvarman did not brook it. arrow

sa: किश्यन्ते पाण्डवा नित्यं वनवासदिभिर्भृशम्। सम्पन्नस्तपसा चैव पर्याप्तः पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Arjuna is always religion abiding and truthful. He will therefore, acquire victory definitely. Nothing like doubt can be raised in it.

sa: भ्यां विद्ध्वा कार्मुकं च ध्वजं चा पुनः पार्थं शरवप्रेण विद्ध्वा द्रौणिोरं सिंहनादं ननाद॥
en: Piercing Bhima's charioteer with six and cutting off his bow and standard with two other arrows and once more piercing Partha with a shower of arrows, the son of Drona uttered a dreadful war-cry.

sa: आक्रोशन्त्यः प्रनृत्यन्ति व्रात्याः पर्वस्वसंयता। तासां किलावलिप्तानां निवसन् कुरुजाङ्गले॥
en: One of those wicked Balhikas who lived amongst them and and for time in Kurujangala burst out with cheerless heart saying-

sa: भयं विपुलमस्मासु तावधत्तां नरोत्तमौ। तेजो विदधतुश्चोग्रं विस्रब्धौ रणमूर्धनि॥
en: Those two foremost of men, displaying fierce energy in battle and confident of their prowess, have filled our hearts with terrors.

sa: अपतत् तच्छिरो राजन् कुण्डलोपचितं महत्॥ शम्बरस्य शिरो यद्वनिहतस्य महारणे। शोचयन् केकयान् सर्वाञ्जगामाशु वसुन्धराम्॥
en: O monarch, that mighty head, adorned with ear-rings, fell like the head of Shambara, slain in that dreadful battle (of old). This, having fallen upon the earth most rapidly, greatly aggrieved all the Kaikayas.

sa: येन मन्दः सहायेन भ्रात्रा दुःशासनेन च॥ वासुदेवस्य दुर्बुद्धिः प्रत्याख्यानमरोचत। स नूनं वृषभस्कन्धं कर्णं दृष्ट्वा निपातितम्॥ दुःशासनं च निहत् मन्ये शोचति पुत्रकः।
en: Having been assisted by that hero as well as by his brother Dushasana, that my evil-souled and wicked-minded son had resolved upon to reject the proposals of Vasudeva himself. I consider that my son, having witnessed the fall of Karna of bull like shoulders and also having seen the slaughter of Dushasana, is surely lamenting.

sa: स पपात रथोपस्थानिरमित्रो जनेश्वरः। त्रिगर्तराजस्य सुतो व्यथयंस्तव वाहिनीम्॥
en: Then Niramitra that son of the Trigartta king, fell down from the terrace of his car, afflicting your troops with woe.

sa: तमभ्ययाद् बृहत्क्षत्रः केकयानां महारथः। प्रवपन् निशितान् बाणान् महेन्द्राशनिसंनिभान्॥
en: Then Vrihatkshatra, that mighty carwarriors among the Kekayas, rushed upon Drona discharging whetted arrows, resembling the thunderbolt of the great Indra.

sa: अनेयश्चाभिमानी च दुर्बुद्धिरजितेन्द्रियः॥ हतोत्साहं बलं दृष्ट्वा किंस्विद् दुर्योधनऽब्रवीत्।
en: What did that undaunted, proud and evil souled Duryodhana of uncontrolled passions say, after beholding his army grown pretty well dispirited?

sa: घोरमार्तस्वरं कृत्वा विदुद्राव महागजः। हाराकारो महानीसीत्तव सैन्यस्य मारिष॥
en: As it careered wildly uttering fierce yells of agony. Then, O sire, loud lamentations arose in the ranks of your soldiers.

sa: ययोलेकि पुमानस्त्रे न समोऽस्ति चतुर्विधे। तौ द्रोणभीष्मौ श्रुत्वा तु हतौ मे व्यथितं मनः॥
en: Those two had not a peer in this world in ihe wielding of the four-fold weapons. Hearing that both Drona and Bhishma were slain in the battle, my mind is greatly pained. was to

sa: अस्मात् परो नो भविता धनुर्धरो नैनं भूतं किंचन जातु जेता। इच्छन्नयं सर्वभूतानि कुर्याद् वशे वशी सर्वसमाप्तविद्यः॥
en: There will be no archer superior to him and none will be able to discomfort him. This boy, being the master of his own senses and adept in all the branches of knowledge, will subjugate all the living beings at his will.

sa: तस्य ज्यातलनिर्घोषं श्रुत्वाशनिसमस्वनम्॥ विमुञ्चन्तः शकृन्मूत्रं गजाः प्रादुद्रुवु शम्।
en: Hearing the twang of his bow resembling the sound of a thunder-bolt the elephants passed urine and excreta and fled away.

sa: वृषसेनस्तु संक्रुद्धो यज्ञसेनं रथे स्थितम्। बहुभिः सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैराजघान स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Thereupon inflamed with wrath, Vrishasena soon struck Yajnasena, stationed on his car, in the centre of his chest with numerous arrows.

sa: निर्दहन् सर्वसैन्यानि पञ्चालानां रथर्षभः। धूमकेतुरिव क्रुद्धः कथं मृत्युमुपेयिवान्॥
en: Consuming all the forces of the Panchalas like an angry comet, how did that foremost of the car-warriors, meet with death?

sa: तव बाहुबलं प्राप्य न शेकुः सर्वसात्वताः॥ तव बाहुबलाद् राजन् किं नु कृष्णो बलाधिकः।
en: All the warriors of the Satvata race are not able to stand, encountering the strength of your arms. O monarch, is the highly powerful Krishna superior to you in the strength of your arms?

sa: त्वं चेत् कर्णसुतं पार्थ सूतपुत्रस्य पश्यतः। प्रतिज्ञावारणार्थाय निहनिष्यसि सायकैः॥ हतं कर्णस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा प्रियं पुत्रं दुरात्मवान्। स्मरतां द्रोणभीष्माभ्यां वचः क्षत्तुश्च मानद॥
en: Partha! You honour always the meritorious people. In case, you kill Vrishasena, son of Karna before his eyes in order to keep your commitment, he will definitely remember the advice given him by Dronacharya, Bhishma and Vidura time to time under influence of agony caused by separation of his son (i.e. so killed by you).

sa: ते बद्धाः पादबन्धेन पाण्डवेन महात्मना। निश्चेष्टाश्चाभवन् राजन्नश्मसारमया इव॥
en: When they were thus bound down by the high-souled son of Pandu, O king, they became inactive like horses and dogs.

sa: नापश्यच्छरणं किञ्चिद् धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। चिन्तयामास राजेन्द्र कथमेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: King Yudhishthira the virtuous could not find any protector for himself. And O foremost of kings, he thought-'how will it end.'.

sa: पश्य भीमेन नाराचैर्भिन्ना नागाः पतन्त्यमी॥ वज्रिवज्रहतानीव शिखराणि धराभृताम्।
en: See, these elephants, struck by Bhima with his Narachas, are dropping down like the summits of mountains clapped by Indra's thunder-bolt.

sa: अदृश्यं वीक्ष्य राजानं भारद्वाजस्य सायकैः। सर्वभूतान्यमन्यन्त हतमेव युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Then beholding the king rendered invincible by the arrows of Bharadvaja's son, all creatures took him to be slain in battle.

sa: तमापतन्तं परिधं जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृतम्। चिच्छेद सहसा राजन् प्रहसन्निव पाण्डवः॥
en: O king, as if smiling. Arjuna all on a sudden cut-off that gold-gilded sword that was about to fall on him.

sa: ततो गाण्डीवनि?षो महानासीद् विशाम्पते। स्तनतां कूजतां चैव मनुष्यगजवाजिनाम्॥
en: The twang of the Gandiva was prominent amid the loud shouts and distressful noises of hosts of men, elephants and horses.

sa: तत् सर्वमनवज्ञाय तथ्यं विज्ञाय भारत। अत्यर्थं प्रतिगृह्याहमस्त्रेष्वेव व्यवस्थितः॥
en: O Bharata, without despising those fine arts which I learnt properly, I specially devoted my attention to the acquisition of arms.

sa: पूज्यमानाश्च वर्धन्ते हव्यकव्यैर्यथाविधि। वयं राष्ट्रस्य गोप्तारो रक्षितारश्च राक्षस॥
en: Being gratified by offerings (offered by men) the celestials prosper. O Rakshasa, we are the guardians, governors and protectors of kingdoms.

sa: येन कर्मविशेषेण प्राप्तेयं शूद्रता त्वया। एतदिच्छामि विज्ञातुं तत्त्वेन हि महामते। कामया ब्रूहि मे सर्वं सत्येन प्रयतात्मना॥
en: You must have been born as a Shudra as a result of your past Karma (in a previous birth). O high-souled one, I eagerly desire to learn truth of this matter. Tell this to me with attention and according to your inclination.

sa: सोऽहमिन्द्रस्य वचनान्नियोगादर्जुनस्य च। रक्षमाणो भयेभ्यस्त्वां चरिष्यामि त्वया सह॥
en: At the request of Indra and also being appointed by Arjuna, I shall travel with you protecting you from all dangers.

sa: सर्वरत्नविचित्रा च भूमिः पुष्पबिभूषिता। मृगद्विजाश्च बहवो रुचिरा मधुरस्वरा:॥
en: (There) the ground is variegated with all sorts of gems and decked with flowers. Various beautiful beasts, birds of sweet voice,

sa: सहस्राणां सहस्राणि प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्। आग्नेयेनार्जुनः संख्ये गन्धर्वाणां बलोत्कटः॥
en: In that battle the greatly powerful Arjuna with his Agneya weapon sent ten lakhs of Gandharvas to the abode of Yama.

sa: चन्दनागुरुकाष्ठानां भारान् कालीयकस्य च। चर्मरत्नसुवर्णानां गन्धानां चैव राशयः॥ कैरातकीनामयुतं दासीनां च विशाम्पते। आहृत्य रमणीयार्थान् दूरजान् मृगपक्षिणः॥
en: O king, having brought loads of Chandana and alone and also black aloes and heaps of valuable skins and much wealth and perfumes, and also ten thousand serving maids of the Kirata race, and many beautiful birds and animals of remote countries.

sa: शिष्टैराचरितंधर्मं कृष्णे मा स्माभिशङ्किथाः। पुराणमृषिभिः प्रोक्तं सर्वज्ञैः सर्वदर्शिभिः॥
en: Doubt not, O Krishna, the ancient religion which is followed by the good and formulated by the omniscient and omnipotent Rishis.

sa: वैकृतं त्वग्निहोत्रे स लक्षयित्वा महातपाः। तमन्धं शूद्रमासीनं गृहपालमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Having seen this change in the Agnihotra, that great ascetic thus spoke to that blind Shudra gate-keeper who was seated there.

sa: स्वर्गं हि गत्वा सशरीर एव को मानुषः पुनरागन्तुमिच्छेत्। अन्यत्र कालोपहताननेकान् समीक्षमाणस्तु कुरून् मुमूर्षुन्॥
en: What man is there who having gone to heaven in his own human body ever wishes to come back? Because he sees the Kurus at the point of death by Time, he has returned.
